There is a variety of accommodation available all with en-suite private bathrooms & all usual comforts in the way of TV & tea & coffee making facilities in each case, comprising two double rooms and one twin room. There are plenty of parking facilities on the property. Prices include full English breakfast. The house is but 200 metres from our village Pub "The Mount Inn" where dinner is served between 7 & 9pm not to mention local Donnington's Cotswold Ales & fine wines all in the most convivial atmosphere amidst stunning views!
short_description: Shenberrow Hill B & B is an attractive country house in 8 acres of the most beautiful part of the North Cotswolds in Stanton, the Cotswolds' most beautiful "hidden treasure" village.

name: The Vine
description: The Vine B & B is in the picturesque village of Stanton, just a few miles from Broadway. Perfect central village location and actually on the national walking trail, the Cotswold Way. Ideal as a touring base too. In the evening you can relax in front of a roaring fire enjoying a hot beverage before snuggling down in the cosy atmosphere of the 17th century bedrooms. A hearty breakfast here will set you up for the days activities. Rooms have shower and wash basin and are serviced by a lavatories just across the landing from the bedrooms. The proprietor also runs a equestrian centre nearby where you can ride on the hills and beyond.
short_description: The Vine B & B is in the picturesque village of Stanton, just a few miles from Broadway. Perfect central village location and actually on the national walking trail, the Cotswold Way.

name: The Stables at The Black Horse
description: Welcome to The Black Horse Inn, nestled in the charming village of Cranham, surrounded by the beautiful Buckholt and Rough woods, and just a stone's throw from The Cotswold Way. Our quintessential Cotswold pub boasts rustic charm, delicious food, locally brewed ales and a fine selection of wines, along with comfortable accommodation. Recently refurbished, community-owned and independently run, The Black Horse Inn represents a fresh start for this beloved landmark, thanks to the incredible efforts of the local community to keep its spirit alive. Come and experience the warmth and hospitality that makes this pub a true gem in the heart of the Cotswolds!
short_description: Welcome to The Black Horse Inn, nestled in the charming village of Cranham, surrounded by the beautiful Buckholt and Rough woods, and just a stone's throw from The Cotswold Way.

name: Woodchester Valley Vineyard
description: Just a short 12-minute drive from the Kings Stanley trailhead of the Cotswold Way, our Vineyard Barns or farmhouse Retreat offer a tranquil countryside stay amidst the vines — ideal for walkers looking for comfort, space and a touch of wine country charm. Each suite features high-end, fully self-contained accommodation. When the weather allows, throw open the bi-fold doors and lounge on your terrace with views over the valley; when it gets cooler, cosy up by the log burner indoors. You'll find everything you need for a relaxing stay — large space, stylish finishes and a peaceful backdrop to unwind after your day on the trail. Walking via Doverow Hill takes you right through part of our working vineyard, making us a uniquely fitting stop-over or rest day for Cotswold Way walkers. We've partnered with local taxi services too, so whether you're arriving from the trail or heading back out, transport is easy to organise. Availability is limited — book early to secure your stay in Cotswold countryside comfort with vineyard views and countryside calm.
short_description: Just a short 12-minute drive from the Kings Stanley trailhead of the Cotswold Way, our Vineyard Barns or farmhouse Retreat offer a tranquil countryside stay amidst the vines — ideal for walkers lookin.

name: The Stroud Hotel
description: Set at the gateway to the Cotswolds and just moments from the iconic Cotswold Way, The Stroud Hotel is a modern boutique escape in the heart of Stroud's historic market town. Independently owned and warmly welcoming, it offers a stylish stay for walkers, weekenders, and those seeking the charm of the countryside with the comforts of contemporary living. Guests can unwind in beautifully appointed rooms before enjoying our acclaimed à la carte menus, featuring everything from seasonal tapas to indulgent bar grazing plates. With an emphasis on quality, provenance, and flavour, our dining experience is elevated by a curated selection of local and English wines - Nyetimber among the stars. Perfectly placed for exploring the surrounding trails, hills, and honey-stone villages, The Stroud Hotel is your elegant basecamp for adventure, rest, and a touch of indulgence.
short_description: Set at the gateway to the Cotswolds and just moments from the iconic Cotswold Way, The Stroud Hotel is a modern boutique escape in the heart of Stroud's historic market town.

name: Cuckoo Penn Hideaway
description: Cuckoo Penn Hideaway is a 3 bedroom Oak framed Lodge situated right on the Cotswold Way at the foot of Penn Woods in Selsley. It is beautifully furnished to suit a walking holiday base.
short_description: Cuckoo Penn Hideaway is a 3 bedroom Oak framed Lodge situated right on the Cotswold Way at the foot of Penn Woods in Selsley. It is beautifully furnished to suit a walking holiday base.

name: Manor Farm Annex
description: The 2 bedroom property; 1 King and 1 Single bedroom, adjoins the our main house but has its own entrance with separate kitchen and living area. It is at the end of a short track in a very quiet location just off the Cotswolds Way going through Kings Stanley. We are usually on hand to help with anything that you may need. Being on the Cotswold Way you have access to great walks in every direction. There is space to store muddy boots, get warm and dry off. Although we don't provide food, with an advanced request we can arrange provisions for weary walkers.
short_description: The 2 bedroom property; 1 King and 1 Single bedroom, adjoins the our main house but has its own entrance with separate kitchen and living area.

name: Cotswold Way Cottage
description: Situated opposite a pub and on the edge of National Trust owned Rodborough Common. This cottage offers quality two bedroom self catering accommodation.
short_description: Situated opposite a pub and on the edge of National Trust owned Rodborough Common. This cottage offers quality two bedroom self catering accommodation.

name: The Cotswold Nook
description: Detached annex (converted garage) with double bed, small sitting area and full bathroom. Private entrance with key box entry. Kettle, tea & coffee provided. Boxed continental breakfast or packed lunch available upon request for a small additional fee. Happy to wash and reuse containers and bottles if arranged in advance.
short_description: Detached annex (converted garage) with double bed, small sitting area and full bathroom. Private entrance with key box entry. Kettle, tea & coffee provided.

name: The Teasel Yurts
description: Yurt glamping experience on the edge of the Cotswolds with spacious decking area overlooking Severn Vale and Stroud Hills. Fully furnished accommodation sleeping up to five with bed linen and towels provided. Woodburning stove inside; covered outdoor kitchen with gas burner, barbecue/firepit, sink and coolbox. No electricity but solarhub powers lights and phone charging. Within walking distance of award-winning Bell Inn pub in Selsley and supermarket five minutes' drive away. Two miles from Stroud market town with farmers' market, artisan food market, cafés, pubs and restaurants. Located on western edge of Cotswolds Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty with easy access to walks and bike rides. Excellent base for day trips to Cheltenham (30 minutes), Bristol (40 minutes) and Bath (50 minutes). No dogs.
short_description: Yurt glamping experience on the edge of the Cotswolds with spacious decking area overlooking Severn Vale and Stroud Hills.

name: Orchardene
description: Orchardene is a Cotswold stone cottage, built in the early 1820's, in rural King Stanley close to Stonehouse and Stroud. We pride ourselves on being a traditional Cotswold bed and breakfast where the welcome is always warm and the breakfast is hearty. If you have had a long day walking the Cotswold Way or a busy day visiting one of the Cotwold's many attractions Orchardene is the ideal place to relax and unwind. Perhaps stay a few days to explore the local walks, (routes can be provided) and see the sights that this still undiscovered area of the Cotswolds has to offer, or stay with us if you are walking the Cotswold Way. All local and organic food – as far as possible!
short_description: Orchardene is a Cotswold stone cottage, built in the early 1820's, in rural King Stanley close to Stonehouse and Stroud.

name: Abbotswingbandb
description: A medieval home with a view of Haresfield Beacon, on the Cotswold Way. Be our guest in part of a romantic 14th century monastic farm with a walled garden. Meticulously restored and furnished. Three double bedrooms. See our website for full information, pictures, the story of our house, and a attractions in our area.
short_description: A medieval home with a view of Haresfield Beacon, on the Cotswold Way. Be our guest in part of a romantic 14th century monastic farm with a walled garden. Meticulously restored and furnished.

name: The Bell Inn Selsley
description: Set in the picturesque and quaint village of Selsley, The Bell Inn is a 16th Century grade two listed, Cotswold Inn. Your friendly country pub with rooms. We are here to give you a true taste of the Cotswolds and all that it has to offer. Serving real ales, locally-sourced food and seasonal game. Whether catching up with friends in our bar, settling down for a traditional Sunday lunch or enjoying a delicious country escape – come and soak up some country life with us. Meet, unwind and celebrate in classic country style. We also offer gin related events in our Gin Tasting room. We love getting people together over great food and drink and have plenty of beautiful spaces to host your meeting or special occasion including a private dining room for dinner parties of up to 14 guests. Whether an awe-inspiring talk, a blissful summer's garden party or a bespoke dinner for that special someone, whatever you need just get in touch and we'll be happy to help make your event go without a hitch. We also offer outside catering including private dinner parties and weddings.
short_description: Set in the picturesque and quaint village of Selsley, The Bell Inn is a 16th Century grade two listed, Cotswold Inn. Your friendly country pub with rooms.

name: Woodchester Lodge B&B
description: Historic, Victorian timber merchant's property. Peaceful village setting near Cotswold Way. Lifts provided to and from trail. Attractive gardens, parking, spacious and comfortable rooms, separate TV lounge/dining room. Afternoon teas bookable - cream tea with scones; Victorian style two course tea; luxury three course tea. Outdoor activities, scenic villages, local attaractions and links to main cities Bath, Bristol, Cheltenham, Gloucester, London and Cardiff.
short_description: Historic, Victorian timber merchant's property. Peaceful village setting near Cotswold Way. Lifts provided to and from trail.

name: Stonehouse Court Hotel
description: A 36-bedroom, 17th century Manor House hotel set in six acres of stunning grounds overlooking the Stroud Water Canal and rolling hills of the Stroud Valley. Our attractive gardens and lawns are the perfect place for a peaceful stroll, glass of Pimms or game of croquet. In the main Manor House you'll find our restaurant, terrace, bar, conference suites, and some guest rooms. Our Garden Wing comprises further guest rooms and the newly-refurbished Caroline Suite offers extensive banqueting and conferencing facilities. From our larger, luxury, newly refurbished Manor House rooms and Four Poster rooms to our smaller more snug Garden Rooms located in the newer extension of the hotel. Stonehouse Court is ideally located for visiting the wealth of local attractions that this beautiful part of England enjoys. We are only 30 miles from the delightful town of Cheltenham Spa and 10 from Gloucester with its breathtaking Cathedral. The many traditional Cotswold villages nearby are perfect for exploring and of course, you may want to sample the local ales in the village pub! Our staff are available for local and seasonal information, directions and recommendations.
short_description: A 36-bedroom, 17th century Manor House hotel set in six acres of stunning grounds overlooking the Stroud Water Canal and rolling hills of the Stroud Valley.

name: Stroud Hotel - Premier Inn
description: Serving up great value heart meals all day is on-site Old Nelson Brewers Fayre.
short_description: Serving up great value heart meals all day is on-site Old Nelson Brewers Fayre.

name: The Beacon & Railway Hotel
description: The Beacon & Railway Hotel is set in the village of Haresfield, in the heart of the Cotswolds. This 19th-century country inn features its own restaurant and cosy bar. Each of the rooms has traditional design with modern touches. All rooms have free Wi-Fi, an iPod docking station, satellite TV and tea and coffee-making facilities. The restaurant serves local produce and you can dine on the patio area during the summer months. The bar offers a range of wines, spirits, lagers and real ales.
short_description: The Beacon & Railway Hotel is set in the village of Haresfield, in the heart of the Cotswolds. This 19th-century country inn features its own restaurant and cosy bar.

name: The Bear of Rodborough
description: Set on 300 acres of National Trust-owned land, this rural 17th-century coaching inn with B&B lodging is 2.3 miles from Stroud and 5.3 miles from the unfinished Woodchester Mansion. In the main property and an annex, the individually decorated rooms and suite feature contemporary country-style furnishings, plus en suite bathrooms with designer toiletries, free WiFi, TVs, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Cooked breakfast is free, and bar/restaurant (with exposed stone walls and modern furnishings) offers British ales and locally sourced food. There are also conference rooms, plus gardens with a walled croquet lawn. Dogs may stay in some rooms
short_description: Set on 300 acres of National Trust-owned land, this rural 17th-century coaching inn with B&B lodging is 2.3 miles from Stroud and 5.3 miles from the unfinished Woodchester Mansion.

name: The Frocester George
description: The Frocester George offers a warm welcome and respite on a cold winter's day and the ideal spot to enjoy sunshine, a cold drink and beautiful rural views on balmy summer evenings. At the bar you'll be tempted by a fine range of real cask conditioned ales, including popular local brews and a number of regularly changing guest beers. We also pride ourselves on an excellent choice of wines with varieties of all the popular grapes on offer and a flavour and price to suit every taste, occasion and pocket. This traditional coach inn is full of character and charm; with ten guest bedrooms, log burning fires, a traditional drinking bar, and a cosy restaurant with a menu full of flavour, quality and freshness. Featuring FREE WiFi and a restaurant, The Frocester offers accommodation central to Bath, Cheltenham, Gloucester & Bristol. The hotel has a terrace and views of the garden, and guests can enjoy a drink at the bar. Free private parking is available on site.
short_description: The Frocester George offers a warm welcome and respite on a cold winter's day and the ideal spot to enjoy sunshine, a cold drink and beautiful rural views on balmy summer evenings.

name: The Grey Cottage
description: Award-winning B&B built of local Cotswold stone circa 1838, located between Leonard Stanley and Kings Stanley villages. Features comfortably furnished ground floor sitting and dining rooms with log fires, flat screen TV, and free WiFi. Three well-appointed bedrooms with various configurations overlooking garden, fields or hills. Room 1 offers super king or twin beds with separate bath and walk-in shower. Room 2 is a single room with 4ft bed and full en suite. Room 3 is a double room with private facilities. All rooms include flat screen TV, beverage facilities, radio, hairdryer, and books. Welcoming tea/coffee and refreshments provided on arrival.
short_description: Award-winning B&B built of local Cotswold stone circa 1838, located between Leonard Stanley and Kings Stanley villages.

name: The White Hart B&B
description: Iconic rural pub established in 1740 with restaurant and bed & breakfast in Leonard Stanley. Features cosy fireplace, 120" sports screen, family and dog friendly. Five spacious, newly refurbished rooms with private bathrooms, exposed beams. Located on Cotswold Way National Trail surrounded by countryside. Hosts live music weekends.
short_description: Iconic rural pub established in 1740 with restaurant and bed & breakfast in Leonard Stanley. Features cosy fireplace, 120" sports screen, family and dog friendly.

name: Rowan Community Dursley
description: Comfortable bedroom in a large house. Shared bathroom and kitchen. Healthy food options, mostly vegetarian and organic. Optional supper for extra fee. This house is close to the trail, and we are a community of people who enjoy organic gardening and local walks. We can help you on your way!
short_description: Comfortable bedroom in a large house. Shared bathroom and kitchen. Healthy food options, mostly vegetarian and organic. Optional supper for extra fee.

name: Starvale Farm
description: Star Vale Farmhouse enjoys a prominent position on Sodbury Common, South Cotswolds. Guests can enjoy uninterrupted views and direct access to explore the common, grazed by cattle from May to December. Just a mile off the Cotswold Way, conveniently located as a peaceful rest stop for walkers. We are also happy to collect and drop off from the trail to save those weary legs! The B & B room is located in the originally part of the 18th Century Farmhouse, accessed via a private staircase with original oak beams and floor boards. A full English breakfast, using locally sourced produce, will be served in the Breakfast room where a wood burning stove is often alight.
short_description: Star Vale Farmhouse enjoys a prominent position on Sodbury Common, South Cotswolds.

name: Hunts Court Huts
description: Hunts Court is located in the village of North Nibley and we are a short distance from the Cotswold Way. We offer camping pitches for tents in our grounds with a shower and toilet block and use of our outdoor kitchen with washing up facilities. At a higher price point, we have two self contained heated glamping pods and a Shepherd's Hut that have their own washroom, kitchenette and double bed. These will need to be booked via our website www.huntscourthuts.co.uk and there is a minimum of a two night stay. No dogs are allowed sorry as we are a working farm with livestock. Cooked breakfasts can be provided by prior arrangement. There is a cafe (T&Cakes) in the village and a pub serving Indian food (The Black Horse) within a short walk.
short_description: Hunts Court is located in the village of North Nibley and we are a short distance from the Cotswold Way.

name: The Holford Arms
description: The Holford Arms is a multi award winning traditional country pub. Situated within 8 green acres with 6 lovely en-suite rooms, 5 luxury Chalets, 4 permanent luxury bell tents, camping and caravan facilities as well as beautiful vegetable gardens, cider orchards and our vineyard. We also host everything from festival weddings to private parties.
short_description: The Holford Arms is a multi award winning traditional country pub.

name: Stinchcombe Hill House
description: Warm and mildly eccentric, Jane and Graham along with a team of animals strive to make your stay as comfortable and relaxing as possible. Sorry no children and no dogs. Guests welcome from 4.30pm for a pot of tea/coffee and a slice of homemade cake. Vacate room by 10.30 am. Breakfast and afternoon tea is included in the price. Breakfast served from 7:30 except on Sundays when it is served between 8 and 10. Full English includes home grown Old Spot cross Saddleback sausages and eggs from chickens, along with bacon, mushrooms, tomatoes, toast and black pudding. Lighter options include cereals, fruit salad, yogurt and toast with homemade jams. Afternoon tea with homemade cake is provided upon arrival, served outside or in the hall of tapestries in front of a log fire depending on weather.
short_description: Warm and mildly eccentric, Jane and Graham along with a team of animals strive to make your stay as comfortable and relaxing as possible. Sorry no children and no dogs.

name: Woodland House B&B Dursley
description: Woodland House is situated in a quiet friendly cul-de-sac, a five minute walk from the historic town of Dursley. It is also a stone's throw away from Stinchcombe Golf Course, and the Cotswold Way. Whether you are an adventurous walker, cyclist, golfer, or just passing through; this is the perfect countryside retreat for you. We are in an ideal location for business people and commuters to Bristol, Gloucester, and surrounding areas. It is our pleasure to host and entertain you as our guests, and to warmly welcome you into our home. We aim to provide a peaceful haven for a time of rest and relaxation. We will do our utmost to make your stay a memorable and enjoyable experience.
short_description: Woodland House is situated in a quiet friendly cul-de-sac, a five minute walk from the historic town of Dursley. It is also a stone's throw away from Stinchcombe Golf Course, and the Cotswold Way.

name: The Old Crown Inn Uley
description: The Old Crown Inn Uley is a beautiful, traditional 17th century freehouse with an enviable position at the top of the village opposite the church and next to the green. The Old Crown is a genuine independent freehouse and has been owned by the same family for over 30 years! We offer; a great range of real ales, wines & drinks, delicious menus which are all freshly made in-house by our talented chef ranging from superb lunches, delectable evening dining to incredible Sunday roasts and not forgetting our leisurely Sunday brunch menu - we also have regular live music, open mic evenings, pub quizzes and so much more! The Crown has been renovated after the pub was returned to us after a 15 year tenancy in 2022 so we are delighted to be open again and pride ourselves on offering a warm welcome and high standard of hospitality throughout. Whether you are walking the Cotswold way, visiting local attractions or simply want to enjoy everything we offer! We have three simple yet comfortable en-suite guest rooms available on a 'bed & breakfast' basis. These rooms have recently been tastefully renovated and include a welcome tray of complimentary refreshments along with luxury Baylis & Harding toiletries. Kate, Tom and the friendly Old Crown Team look forward to welcoming you! We love dogs at the Crown and they are very welcome. We have biscuits always available on the bar which you can help yourself to and if you would like any water please just ask. The only thing we ask is that they are well behaved and on a lead.
short_description: The Old Crown Inn Uley is a beautiful, traditional 17th century freehouse with an enviable position at the top of the village opposite the church and next to the green.

name: The Black Horse Inn North Nibley
description: The 3-star Black Horse Inn North Nibley is set 3.9 km from Cotswold Edge Golf Club and 4.4 km from Stinchcombe Hill Golf Club. Free Wi Fi is available throughout the venue, and a restaurant, a business centre and a tennis court are on-site. The accommodation is set within 5 minutes' walk of the centre of North Nibley, not far from The Chapel. It is 23 km to Malmesbury. A short driving distance to Cam Peak is a perk for guests staying at The Black Horse Inn. The hotel comprises non-smoking rooms with comforts such as TV, climate control and satellite television. For more comfort bath sheets, hair dryers and towels are provided. The bar's menu offers various types of ciders and ales. A local bus stop Black Horse Inn is 50 metres away. Pets are allowed.
short_description: The 3-star Black Horse Inn North Nibley is set 3.9 km from Cotswold Edge Golf Club and 4.4 km from Stinchcombe Hill Golf Club.

name: Owlpen Manor Estate
description: Deep in a Cotswold valley, Owlpen Manor has been described as the most beautiful place in England. The tudor manor house is steeped in 800 years of history, with arts and crafts furniture and its own community of ghosts. The nine self-catering Cotswold holiday cottages are all dog-friendly and perfect for families. They offer an unforgettable stay in this hidden corner of Gloucestershire, and sleep between two and eight people. Enjoy exclusive use of our stunning private Cotswold wedding venue and events venue, centred around the Cyder House restaurant, a stunning stone barn built in 1446. Visit Owlpen to explore the magical gardens, enjoy miles of woodland walks and relax in this truly English hidden gem. We have nine beautiful self-catering holiday cottages at Owlpen Manor which sleep 36 people in total, in houses, barns and woodland homes for between 2 and 8 people.
short_description: Deep in a Cotswold valley, Owlpen Manor has been described as the most beautiful place in England.

name: Burrows Court
description: An historic grade two listed country house that adjoins a weaving mill at Nibley green, just outside the village of North Nibley. The house is set over three floors, each of the four bedrooms has an ensuite. On the ground floor there is a sitting room and well equipped kitchen with oven, microwave, dishwasher, washing machine and dryer.
short_description: An historic grade two listed country house that adjoins a weaving mill at Nibley green, just outside the village of North Nibley.

name: Rounceval House Chipping Sodbury
description: Stunning 17th century Cotswolds townhouse annexe in Chipping Sodbury near Cotswold Way. Self catering with own kitchen. Sleeps six. Air BnB superhosts for eight years. Rated 4.85/5
short_description: Stunning 17th century Cotswolds townhouse annexe in Chipping Sodbury near Cotswold Way. Self catering with own kitchen. Sleeps six. Air BnB superhosts for eight years. Rated 4.85/5

name: Woodcock Farm Glamping
description: Peaceful glamping site on a Gloucestershire working farm in secluded woodland on the edge of the Cotswolds, 30 minutes' drive from Bath and Bristol. Features private woodlands, Iron Age hill fort, and proximity to the 102-mile Cotswold Way National Trail. Off-grid with composting toilet and solar shower.
short_description: Peaceful glamping site on a Gloucestershire working farm in secluded woodland on the edge of the Cotswolds, 30 minutes' drive from Bath and Bristol.

name: Hideaway Horton
description: Escape back to nature in one of our luxuriously appointed, totally secluded, off-grid glamping pods, Upper Hen and Greenditch. Located on our working family farm in an area of outstanding natural beauty on the Cotswold escarpment, each is positioned in separate corners on the banks of our private 2 acre fishing lake, tucked away so that guests can completely unwind and relax. Guests can take advantage of stunning rural walks with direct access onto the Cotswold Way National trail which crosses the farm.
short_description: Escape back to nature in one of our luxuriously appointed, totally secluded, off-grid glamping pods, Upper Hen and Greenditch.

name: The Dog Inn B&B Old Sodbury
description: A family and dog friendly village pub with great food, ales and rooms, in the pretty village of Old Sodbury close to both Bristol and Bath. The Dog Inn is over 500 years old and retains all it's character and charm and a great beer garden too! We have four lovely rooms which have all been recently refurbished to a high standard. All the rooms are located to the rear of the pub, leading into the garden and our delicious breakfast is served in the pub. A full English breakfast is included in all of our prices. The Dog Inn really is the perfect place to spend quality time with family and friends as we always have something special on offer – keep warm by the fire when it is cold outside, while in summer you and the kids will enjoy our large beer garden and children's play area.
short_description: A family and dog friendly village pub with great food, ales and rooms, in the pretty village of Old Sodbury close to both Bristol and Bath.

name: Sodbury House Hotel
description: Situated in its own spacious grounds of lawns and fruit trees, this former farmstead dates from the 1700's, its rustic charm complemented by modern restoration. The word 'hotel' in any language evokes a haven of warmth and comfort and this small country hotel epitomises just that. Businessmen soon recognise high standards of service, reliability and efficiency: the early call that is not forgotten, fresh orange juice at breakfast; and the importance of intelligently relaying a message ungarbled to a guest from his office is not lost on us. While it is natural that we should be popular with some of our biggest firms and government departments - being near to the bustling commerce of Yate and Bristol, we are also near to Bath and the glorious Cotswolds for those seeking leisure, sightseeing and shopping. There are 7 rooms, all with private facilities, and some are for family use with an extra bed. All have colour TV, direct dial phone, trouser press, etc. All rates are per night and include full breakfast and all taxes.
short_description: Situated in its own spacious grounds of lawns and fruit trees, this former farmstead dates from the 1700's, its rustic charm complemented by modern restoration.

name: Hammerdown B&B Old Sodbury
description: The accommodation has its own entrance and consists of a double bedroom and shower room, in addition to a large kitchen / dining / living area. Bed & Breakfast: Single occupancy: From £40 per person / per night (Includes Continental Breakfast). Double occupancy From £58 per suite / per night (Includes Continental Breakfast).
short_description: The accommodation has its own entrance and consists of a double bedroom and shower room, in addition to a large kitchen / dining / living area.

name: Denison Cottage
description: Scandinavian cabin situated in beautiful 2 acre garden in an area of outstanding natural beauty
short_description: Scandinavian cabin situated in beautiful 2 acre garden in an area of outstanding natural beauty

name: Cross Hands Old Sodbury
description: This charming 14th-century posting house lies near the village of Old Sodbury, on the edge of the beautiful Cotswolds. The Cross Hands is a lovely, welcoming hotel; it blends old world charm with fresh, modern décor beautifully. In fact, in 1981, even Queen Elizabeth II took advantage of our renowned hospitality after being caught in a winter blizzard! There are 21 bedrooms. The lovely mix of old and new décor really is fit for royalty! This is a pet friendly hotel.
short_description: This charming 14th-century posting house lies near the village of Old Sodbury, on the edge of the beautiful Cotswolds.

name: Cottage Courtyard Totteroak Farm
description: Cottage courtyard is a unique development of former farm buildings connected to a Cotswold stone farmhouse dating back over three hundred years. Its unique situation nestling in the foot of the Cotswold hills only, half a mile from the Cotswold Way, 18 minutes from the regency town of Bath, 12 minutes from Westonbirt arboretum and close distance from the Badminton estate make it a fantastic base to explore the south Cotswolds. It is a short walk to a superb golf course and a mile and a half from the ancient market town of Chipping Sodbury with its great selection of pubs and restaurants. The property offers self catering holiday accommodation and weekend breaks.
short_description: Cottage courtyard is a unique development of former farm buildings connected to a Cotswold stone farmhouse dating back over three hundred years.

name: Noth Farmcote B & B
description: A country house B & B on a working, family farm situated high on the Cotswold escarpment with the Cotswold Way traversing the farm, three miles east of Winchcombe. North Farmcote is in an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty with panoramic views to the Malvern Hills and the Welsh Mountains beyond.
short_description: A country house B & B on a working, family farm situated high on the Cotswold escarpment with the Cotswold Way traversing the farm, three miles east of Winchcombe.

name: Cotswold Shepherd Huts
description: Luxury Shepherd Hut with stunning views
short_description: Luxury Shepherd Hut with stunning views

name: Winchcombe Camping and Caravanning Site
description: A quiet campsite in the heart of the Cotswolds near Alderton village, featuring a carp pool, games room, dog walk, and site shop with local produce. The 42-mile Winchcombe Way trail runs adjacent to the site. Winchcombe town offers restaurants, pubs, and tea shops with Walkers are Welcome status. Glamping and self-catering lodges available alongside traditional camping pitches.
short_description: A quiet campsite in the heart of the Cotswolds near Alderton village, featuring a carp pool, games room, dog walk, and site shop with local produce.
host_name: Winchcombe Camping and Caravanning Club Site

name: North Farmcote B&B
description: A country house b&b on a working family farm situated high on the Cotswold escarpment producing sheep and cereals. North Farmcote is in an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty with panoramic views across to the Malvern Hills and Welsh mountains beyond. An ideal centre for touring and walking with The Cotswold Way traversing the farm. Our Gloucestershire farm house bed and breakfast is 3 miles east of Winchcombe and open all year. The house was built around 1840 as a dower house for Lord Sudley's mother. It has a flagstoned hall entrance leading to comfortable, spacious accomodation upstairs. The house is surrounded by a large garden where guests can have afternoon tea on the terrace in the summer and enjoy the view. In the winter tea is served in front of a log fire. There are three rooms, all large enough for a third bed if necessary. The tariff includes full English breakfast.
short_description: A country house b&b on a working family farm situated high on the Cotswold escarpment producing sheep and cereals.

name: The Barn Reborn
description: Just yards from the Cotswold Way, this spacious detached barn for two people, dating from about 1650, is a perfect walkers' base. Bus connections can help you cover much of the northern part of the route, from Chipping Campden as far as Painswick. There is underfloor heating, a woodburning stove and two bathrooms. Winchcombe offers a wide range of eating and drinking places, just 400 metres away from the barn. And at the end of the evening, you can relax in a 6ft bed well removed from traffic noise.
short_description: Just yards from the Cotswold Way, this spacious detached barn for two people, dating from about 1650, is a perfect walkers' base.

name: The Plaisterers Arms
description: Two-bar, multi-level 15th century pub in the centre of ancient Saxon town. Large garden at rear with a decorative patio and children's facility. Good choice of home cooked food.
short_description: Two-bar, multi-level 15th century pub in the centre of ancient Saxon town. Large garden at rear with a decorative patio and children's facility. Good choice of home cooked food.

name: The Plough Inn Ford
description: Sitting in the hamlet of Ford, this popular 16th Century Inn is renowned for its excellent menu, serving fresh local produce and fine Donnington Ales. The Plough has three bed & breakfast rooms provided in the Tallot, a converted hayloft with stabling below. Three comfortable en-suite shower rooms are available with beamed ceilings. Two family rooms (double and single bed) and one double room are offered, all non-smoking with Full English Breakfast included. The area offers walking, cycling, fishing and golf opportunities, with views of the gallops nearby. Winner of Cotswold Food & Drink 'Cotswold Best Pub Award 2017' and voted Racing pub of the year in 2008.
short_description: Sitting in the hamlet of Ford, this popular 16th Century Inn is renowned for its excellent menu, serving fresh local produce and fine Donnington Ales.

name: Wesley House
description: Wesley House is a 15th century Merchant's House in the historic Anglo Saxon town of Winchcombe in the Cotswolds. Noted as one of Britain's Top 50 Cosiest Hotels - The Telegraph 2015. Five individually decorated rooms provide memorable accommodation for a short Cotswolds break. Our cosy bedrooms have en-suite shower rooms and are individually furnished. The double rooms are named after the fields surrounding Sudeley Castle of which one, "Almsbury", has a private terrace overlooking the North Cotswold Edge. The Castle itself can be seen from here in Winter, once the leaves have fallen. Our twin bedroom is know as "The Preacher's Room" since the founder of the Methodist Church, John Wesley, stayed here twice in 1755 and 1779 as a guest of the then owner of the building, John Stait, whilst preaching in the town.
short_description: Wesley House is a 15th century Merchant's House in the historic Anglo Saxon town of Winchcombe in the Cotswolds. Noted as one of Britain's Top 50 Cosiest Hotels - The Telegraph 2015.

name: Elms Farm B&B
description: Located on the outskirts of Gretton. A large modern farmhouse on a working farm set in peaceful surroundings. Within easy reach of Winchcombe and ideal for touring the Cotswolds. We offer free transfers to walking start points. Nestled in the heart of the country-side, our farmhouse accommodation is perfectly located for the weekend break or a leisurely mid-week holiday. Double and Twin rooms available all with ensuite facilities. Enjoy a welcoming pot of tea and homemade cake/biscuits on arrival.
short_description: Located on the outskirts of Gretton. A large modern farmhouse on a working farm set in peaceful surroundings. Within easy reach of Winchcombe and ideal for touring the Cotswolds.

name: Byways House B&B
description: As keen walkers, Geoff and Sally are happy to share their local knowledge. This homely B&B is a short walk from the local pub. The Manor View Room is a light and airy room with beautiful views of Gretton Hill, Manor Farm and the impressive Manor House - a perfect example of typical Cotswold stone architecture. The room can be arranged as a kingsize bed or two singles beds and has a private bathroom.
short_description: As keen walkers, Geoff and Sally are happy to share their local knowledge. This homely B&B is a short walk from the local pub.

name: Blair House
description: Blair House is an attractive Georgian home situated in the Saxon town of Winchcombe within walking distance of local pubs, restaurants and shops. There is a Tourist Information Centre open during the summer months. We are also close to the Cotswold Way and other walks. One double room (on the ground floor), one twin room, and one single room (both on the first floor).
short_description: Blair House is an attractive Georgian home situated in the Saxon town of Winchcombe within walking distance of local pubs, restaurants and shops.

name: Postlip Hall Farm
description: This impressive mellow stone Cotswold farmhouse offers cosy, comfortable, well equipped and spacious accommodation. Bedrooms are en suite or with private facilities, TV's, beverages, armchairs and many other homely extras. There is a beautiful guest lounge, attractive dining room and a large well tended garden to relax in and enjoy the views across the countryside towards Winchcombe. Postlip is very much a family run farm, Joe (husband) works in partnership with two of our sons, Richard and Edward. The Farmhouse B & B side is also very much a family affair with myself (Valerie) running it but Joe, Joanna (daughter) and sons all taking a very active part. We have excellent off road parking and guests are welcome to walk around the farm, lambing time is between February and April and is always popular with the visitors.
short_description: This impressive mellow stone Cotswold farmhouse offers cosy, comfortable, well equipped and spacious accommodation.

name: The Trieste
description: Standing proudly in the hamlet of Postlip The Trieste offers the perfect getaway with friends and family. Sitting on one acre of private land with a beautiful stream running through the grounds The Trieste gives you total privacy. Open all year round the house has accommodation for up to six guests. In addition to the gardens and stream Postlip is surrounded by outstanding countryside. With the rolling hills of Cleeve Common and the Cotswold Way on your doorstep The Trieste is a paradise for the walker and outdoor enthusiast.
short_description: Standing proudly in the hamlet of Postlip The Trieste offers the perfect getaway with friends and family.

name: Seven Springs Holiday Cottages
description: Nestled in the heart of the Cotswolds, Seven Springs Cotswold Cottages offer comfortable self-catering holiday cottages to those wanting to explore quintessential England. With Cheltenham, Gloucester, Cirencester and a host of Cotswold villages nearby, these purpose built cotswold holiday cottages are a great place to kick back and relax all year round. Week long breaks - Prices are per property and are based on a stay of seven nights, starting on a Friday, Saturday or Monday.
short_description: Nestled in the heart of the Cotswolds, Seven Springs Cotswold Cottages offer comfortable self-catering holiday cottages to those wanting to explore quintessential England.

name: The Green Dragon Inn Cockleford
description: Situated in the heart of the Cotswolds, the hamlet of Cockleford provides a tranquil and picturesque setting for rest and relaxation. For visitors seeking an alternative to the bland uniformity of many a modern town centre hotel, The Green Dragon Inn offers an appealing individuality – hand crafted bars and furniture by the famous Robert Thompson (the Mouse Man of Killburn), roaring log fires, beamed ceilings and stone flagged floors all set the scene for a relaxing experience. Dating from the 17th century, the Inn has proven to be a popular retreat for those appreciating good food, fine wine, real ales and comfortable cottage-style accommodation. We have nine comfortable bedrooms, each individually furnished to a high standard, with their own en-suite bathrooms.
short_description: Situated in the heart of the Cotswolds, the hamlet of Cockleford provides a tranquil and picturesque setting for rest and relaxation.

name: Cowley Manor Hotel (and Spa)
description: Timelessly stylish, Cowley Manor is the original contemporary country house hotel. With a grand Italianate exterior, and bold iconic interiors, it is the perfect choice for couples, families and groups alike. Featuring 30 bedrooms, a multi-award winning spa including heated indoor & outdoor pools, locally sourced food and 55 acres of Grade II listed gardens, Cowley Manor is the perfect place for a getaway in the Cotswolds.
short_description: Timelessly stylish, Cowley Manor is the original contemporary country house hotel.

name: Royal George Hotel (Birdlip)
description: Surrounded by 26 acres of beautiful grounds, Royal George Hotel offers free Wi-Fi, real ales, and serves food all day. Set on the Cotswold Way, it is 15 minutes' drive from Cheltenham and Gloucester. Each room is slightly different in style, but all have free Wi-Fi, satellite TV and a bathroom. Some rooms open onto the garden. Traditional meals and lighter snacks are served every day, until 22:00. The Royal George often hosts live music or a quiz in the evening. Outdoor dining is possible in the garden and heated terrace. Located in Birdlip village, the 18th-century hotel has a free car park and fine views over the peaceful Gloucestershire countryside.
short_description: Surrounded by 26 acres of beautiful grounds, Royal George Hotel offers free Wi-Fi, real ales, and serves food all day. Set on the Cotswold Way, it is 15 minutes' drive from Cheltenham and Gloucester.

name: Pigeon House Cottage B&B
description: Pigeon House Cottage offers beautiful accommodation amidst stunning 14th Century surroundings.
short_description: Pigeon House Cottage offers beautiful accommodation amidst stunning 14th Century surroundings.

name: The Walnut Store
description: Designed by a local architect, the accommodation is separate from the main house, offering modern rooms with lots of privacy. Located within walking distance of Cheltenham Racecourse and Regency Cheltenham, ideal base for exploring the Cotswolds and the Cotswold Way. Features two luxury en-suite double bedrooms in a recently completed annexe with natural light. Private swimming pool available for guests in summer months. Wonderful local pubs and restaurants nearby.
short_description: Designed by a local architect, the accommodation is separate from the main house, offering modern rooms with lots of privacy.

name: Cottage from Country Cottages Online
description: For over 20 years, Country Cottages Online have been helping holidaymakers find rural retreats and country cottages in popular holiday destinations across Britain. Whether you're searching for a log cabin, a barn conversion, a holiday farmhouse or a country cottage, we feature a great choice of holiday rentals. We feature a great selection of holiday properties near the National Trails, from romantic retreats to hot tub cottages and pet-friendly rentals.
short_description: For over 20 years, Country Cottages Online have been helping holidaymakers find rural retreats and country cottages in popular holiday destinations across Britain.

name: Ellenborough Park (Hotel & Spa)
description: For unparalleled comfort and a truly unforgettable experience, there can only be one choice when it comes to staying in Cheltenham. Ellenborough Park boasts lavish bedrooms, a serene spa, small fitness suite, relaxed pub and bar, fine dining restaurant and truly bespoke service; everything you could possibly need for a relaxing getaway in the Cotswolds. An indulgent 15th century country estate with the perfect fusion of tradition and modernity, we have seen the house evolve into a 21st century retreat. At the foot of Cleeve Hill, the Hotel is caught between the Cotswolds' highest point and the lush green gallops of Cheltenham's world-famous racecourse, our luxury 5 star hotel in the Cotswolds is steeped in history and offers 90 acres of rustic countryside to call your own during your stay.
short_description: For unparalleled comfort and a truly unforgettable experience, there can only be one choice when it comes to staying in Cheltenham.

name: 43 Welland Lodge Road
description: Quiet location with views of Cleeve Hill. Parking on drive or street. 15 min walk to Theatre. Hourly bus to town during day. 1x Single Room 1x Family room (3beds) Private facilities for guests use
short_description: Quiet location with views of Cleeve Hill. Parking on drive or street. 15 min walk to Theatre. Hourly bus to town during day. 1x Single Room 1x Family room (3beds) Private facilities for guests use

name: Malvern View Bed & Breakfast
description: Nestled in to Cleeve Common and The Cotswolds Way, Malvern View offers 7 comfortable guest rooms with rain showers, Egyptian cotton bedding, full hospitality trays, ipod docks, 32" Smart flatscreen T.V's and complimentary toilettries as standard. We offer a hearty breakfast and there is a pub nearby which serves food all day for evening meals. We're happy to provide packed lunches. Please note: we only accept bookings of two nights or more.
short_description: Nestled in to Cleeve Common and The Cotswolds Way, Malvern View offers 7 comfortable guest rooms with rain showers, Egyptian cotton bedding, full hospitality trays, ipod docks, 32" Smart flatscreen T.

name: Cleeve Hill House Hotel
description: We are a privately owned and operated Bed and Breakfast business and pride ourselves on making each of our guests feel cherished whilst they stay with us. Guests are assured of the personal attention that only a small privately owned guest house can offer. Great importance is placed on comfort and providing a warm and relaxed atmosphere in which guests can unwind. Our elegant hotel sits close to the top of Cleeve Hill, which is the highest point in the Cotswolds and commands exceptional views across Cheltenham to the Malvern Hills, whilst being ideally located for exploring Cheltenham Spa, Winchcombe, Broadway, Tewkesbury, Stratford and the picturesque villages that make the Cotswolds world famous. All prices are per room and include Full English Breakfast.
short_description: We are a privately owned and operated Bed and Breakfast business and pride ourselves on making each of our guests feel cherished whilst they stay with us.

name: Pettifers Freehouse Hotel
description: Family owned & operated 16c Veterinary Apothecaries conversion, all ensuite, mix of single, double/twin, family/triple and Accessible rooms + Rental Cottage. Uber Dog Friendly – bistro & bar, open plan with terrace & gardens and 3 large free car parks – dining locally sourced & quirky dishes, open all year 7 days a week. Fosse Way runs through Village, Thames Path and Cotswold Way both within 10 mins (by car) – help with transport/planning – many new & returning Walking & Cycling Groups.
short_description: Family owned & operated 16c Veterinary Apothecaries conversion, all ensuite, mix of single, double/twin, family/triple and Accessible rooms + Rental Cottage.

name: Gatekeepers Lodge at Dyrham Park
description: Totally Private, 2 person Self-Contained & Self Catered Cottage with Kitchenette, Gardens and BBQ. The Cotswold Way runs past the front door! Breakfast Available, Luggage Storage and Transportation Available. Free Parking for 2 cars. Fully renovated in 2020 & exclusively let to you, Gatekeepers Lodge is a bijou country retreat located adjacent to 17th Century Dyrham Park. The perfect location to explore Bath, Bristol & many Cotswold Villages, after which you can relax in your own private gardens. A Walkers & Cyclists dream, complete with amenities for storing and cleaning outdoor equipment, the Cotswold Way & national cycle routes run past the front door.
short_description: Totally Private, 2 person Self-Contained & Self Catered Cottage with Kitchenette, Gardens and BBQ.

name: The Compass Inn Tormarton
description: BEST WESTERN The Compass Inn is a medium sized, family run, hotel set in the beautiful South Cotswolds. An 18th century coaching inn with modern accommodation set in 6 acres of beautifully kept grounds and gardens. The Orangery Restaurant, under Head chef Hugo de Bonneval, has a reputation for using the very best of local produce and seasonal game, as well as a fine wine list. Both menus are served in the Orangery, Vittles, Bar and Lounge areas throughout the day. Relax in the comfort of one of our 26 en suite bedrooms which have been carefully designed for both business and pleasure, with digital television, telephone, tea & coffee making facilities and a mini-bar/fridge in every room to help make your stay more comfortable.
short_description: BEST WESTERN The Compass Inn is a medium sized, family run, hotel set in the beautiful South Cotswolds.

name: The Crown Inn Tolldown
description: Just 10 miles from Bath and 14 miles from Bristol, the Crown Inn at Tolldown offers stylish self-contained accommodation and a high-quality food menu. A 10-minute drive from the pretty town of Chipping Sodbury, this traditional south Gloucestershire inn provides free parking and WiFi. Each guest room has a flat-screen TV, desk and tea and coffee facilities. The en suite bathrooms have either a walk-in shower or a bath and shower, with a hairdryer and toiletries provided. All rooms are ground floor, and there is one that is an accessible room. The pub is fully accessible and is also ground floor only. The Crown Inn showcases regional specialities in its restaurant menu, with Wiltshire ham, Wyfe of Bath cheese, and steaks and sausages from Devizes butcher Walter Rose.
short_description: Just 10 miles from Bath and 14 miles from Bristol, the Crown Inn at Tolldown offers stylish self-contained accommodation and a high-quality food menu.

name: Old Hundred Coach House
description: Converted C19 coach house, loft is now guest bedroom with doors overlooking countryside and gardens. TV, WiFi and tea and coffee making facilities in room. Rates are £40 per night pp or £70 per couple, which includes full English breakfast if required or similar. Vegan, Vegetarian and gluten/lactose free accommodated, if notified in advance. The bathroom with separate shower is adjacent to the room, one step away, and not shared. The one dog would be welcome. Free parking within gate or on driveway. Packed lunches if necessary for a small charge. Our local pub has now closed completely but we can give a lift to anyone wanting an evening meal at The Compass, Tormarton, if required.
short_description: Converted C19 coach house, loft is now guest bedroom with doors overlooking countryside and gardens. TV, WiFi and tea and coffee making facilities in room.

name: Best Western Compass Inn Tormarton
description: The Best Western Compass Inn Hotel is nestled in the countryside, 9 miles from Bristol. On the edge of the Cotswolds, it stands in 6 acres of beautiful grounds with ample walks nearby. The hotel offers convenient access to M4 and M5 motorways, suitable for events and functions.
short_description: The Best Western Compass Inn Hotel is nestled in the countryside, 9 miles from Bristol. On the edge of the Cotswolds, it stands in 6 acres of beautiful grounds with ample walks nearby.

name: Noades Studio Tormarton
description: Contemporary 1 bed fully equipped selfcatering studio located directly on Cotswold Way in the village of Tormarton 10 miles north of Bath. The Studio comprises a light and airy, double height, fully fitted kitchen/living room with French windows which lead onto the garden, together with an exposed beam double bedroom and en-suite toilet and shower room. A Welcome Hamper of local produce including milk, bed linen and towels is provided. Home cooked meals, a laundry service or even a fully stocked kitchen are available as optional extras.
short_description: Contemporary 1 bed fully equipped selfcatering studio located directly on Cotswold Way in the village of Tormarton 10 miles north of Bath.

name: Fosse Farmhouse B&B Nettleton
description: Fosse Farmhouse B&B is located on the Cotswolds Way just eight miles from Bath Spa. This charming Georgian property has three B&B guest bedrooms one double, a twin and a family room all with ensuite bathrooms together with three self catering holiday cottages sleeping from 2 -16 guests. During the summer months we serve delicious home made Cream Teas in the former Cider Apple Orchard and during the winter weekends Toasted Tea Cakes and Crumpets beside the fire in the cosy Farmhouse dining room. While walking the Cotswolds way do stop by and stay the night or just have a rewarding cup of tea! We would love to see you and welcome you to our happy family home.
short_description: Fosse Farmhouse B&B is located on the Cotswolds Way just eight miles from Bath Spa.

name: Chestnut Farm Tormarton
description: Constructed of Cotswold Stone, Chestnut Farm is surrounded by gardens and fields, it was built in 1828 by the 9th Duke of Beaufort and is situated on the edge of the village of Tormarton. My Wife Heather and I (Roberto) have run the farm as a guesthouse since 1994 and have made many improvements to the existing buildings. All of the bedrooms are en suite and have tea and coffee making facilities, colour television, heating and either twin or double bed. Cots can be provided and dogs are welcome, Packed Lunches are available.
short_description: Constructed of Cotswold Stone, Chestnut Farm is surrounded by gardens and fields, it was built in 1828 by the 9th Duke of Beaufort and is situated on the edge of the village of Tormarton.

name: The Annexe Yew Tree Cottage
description: The Annexe is a one-bedroom self-catering cottage located 4 miles from the Cotswold Way, surrounded by footpaths. It features a comfortable bedroom with a sumptuous bed, a naturally lit living area for relaxation, and is positioned in a secluded lane ideal for hikers and nature lovers seeking tranquility and connection with the natural world.
short_description: The Annexe is a one-bedroom self-catering cottage located 4 miles from the Cotswold Way, surrounded by footpaths.

name: The Old Swan Holiday Lets Pennsylvania
Toghill House Farm Cold Ashton
description: A beautiful historic guesthouse and working farm on the edge of the Cotswolds. Toghill House was built in 1691 and originally used as a resting house for monks travelling between Glastonbury and Malmesbury. It was restored in 1861 as a working farm and now offers a traditional B&B service for the travellers of today exploring this charming part of the country. Visitors to Toghill can relax in rooms in the main farmhouse or barn conversion, all of which have been carefully decorated to reflect the history of the buildings. Our guesthouse also boasts stunning views over the River Severn, the Bristol Channel, the hills of Wales and the Brecon Beacons.
short_description: A beautiful historic guesthouse and working farm on the edge of the Cotswolds.

name: Hill Farm Accommodation Cold Ashton
description: Hill Farm is directly on the Cotswold Way, 8 miles from Bath. We can accommodate up to 4 people. We have one double room and another room that converts into a twin or double. We are well set up for walkers with boot and clothes drying facilities, home cooked evening meals and a relaxing, quiet setting away from main roads. Our outside sitting area overlooks the valley.  Please take a look at our website for further details and photographs.
short_description: Hill Farm is directly on the Cotswold Way, 8 miles from Bath. We can accommodate up to 4 people. We have one double room and another room that converts into a twin or double.

name: Pond Cottage B&B
description: Just a 3.5-mile detour from the Cotswold Way at Stinchcombe Hill, Pond Cottage offers comfortable, characterful accommodation for the discerning walker—an inviting haven on a stretch of the trail where good-quality places to stay become surprisingly scarce once you've left the delights of Painswick behind. Walkers can enjoy a hearty, home-cooked dinner and be dropped back at the Cotswolds Way after breakfast the next morning to continue on their journey. Alternatively there is the option to spend a day (or two) enjoying suggested circular walks from Pond Cottage taking in the Saxon market town of Berkeley and its famous 12th century castle or experiencing the intriguing Purton Ships Graveyard along the banks of the River Severn and Gloucester & Sharpness Canal. Originally 19th-century farm buildings, Pond Cottage was sympathetically rebuilt and restored in 2023, retaining its rustic character while providing comfortable accommodation. Set within three acres of private gardens, Pond Cottage sits beside a natural pond framed by mature oaks, with an English country garden, wild meadows, and an old orchard for guests to enjoy.
short_description: Just a 3.5-mile detour from the Cotswold Way at Stinchcombe Hill, Pond Cottage offers comfortable, characterful accommodation for the discerning walker—an inviting haven on a stretch of the trail wher.

name: Coppice Ridge
description: Great views, cosy house and near many national trails – Cotswold Way, MacmillanWay, Wysis Way etc. Lifts to and from start/end points possible. Breakfast included. Packed lunch by arrangement. Pubs nearby for an evening meal. Comfortable double room with shared bathroom across corridor. Own lounge and entrance. Can have use of kitchen, washing machine, dryer if needed. You will have your own double room with a bathroom across the corridor. There is a bath and shower with shampoo and shower gel for you to use. You also have use of your own lounge downstairs. Coffee and tea making facilities in the room. We have 2 cats: one fluffy and one ginger. A bit shy so will keep out of your way.
short_description: Great views, cosy house and near many national trails – Cotswold Way, MacmillanWay, Wysis Way etc. Lifts to and from start/end points possible. Breakfast included. Packed lunch by arrangement.

name: Dove Cottage Holidays
description: Dove cottage is a grade 2 listed building with exposed stone walls, huge oak beams, log burner, underfloor heating and beautiful views down the valley below. It's nestled in the tranquil lanes of the beautiful Bisley village in the south Cotswolds, right opposite the Wells of Bisley
short_description: Dove cottage is a grade 2 listed building with exposed stone walls, huge oak beams, log burner, underfloor heating and beautiful views down the valley below.

name: Croft House Guest Suite Painswick
description: Croft House is located in Painswick, referred to as the 'Queen Of The Cotswolds'. It is one of the best-preserved settlements in the Cotswolds, with countryside setting and beautiful Cotswold stone buildings. Painswick is central to the Cotswold Way and surrounded by areas of outstanding natural beauty, making it a great base for walkers. The town features galleries, shops, pubs and restaurants serving locally sourced food and ales. Attractions include an 18-hole golf course, the church of St Mary and the Rococo Garden. 'The Gloucester' suite is at ground level with private entry from Gloucester Street. The bedroom and en-suite bathroom are generous in size, including bath and separate shower with pressurised large rain head. 'The Garden Room' is also at ground level with independent access. The light, spacious bedroom has full view of the garden and features a log burning stove. Both rooms feature a comfortable queen size bed, sofa seating for two, wide screen TV and free Wi-Fi Internet access.
short_description: Croft House is located in Painswick, referred to as the 'Queen Of The Cotswolds'.

name: Randwick Studio
description: Randick Studio is in the heart of the village a stones throw from the Cotswold Way. A studio with a double bed, kitchenette, shower room and south facing terrace. A breakfast is included. We are listed on the usual bnb websites or can be contacted directly @Randwickstudio, For reviews and more photos view the other websites. Thanks
short_description: Randick Studio is in the heart of the village a stones throw from the Cotswold Way. A studio with a double bed, kitchenette, shower room and south facing terrace. A breakfast is included.

name: Farm View House
description: Farm View House is new this year to the Bed and Breakfast market and offers peaceful and relaxing accommodation in the country near Painswick, Sheepscombe and Stroud. This exciting project is a work in progress and so particularly welcomes walkers and muddy boots! The house lies on the Wysis Way and is within half an hour's walk of some wonderful country pubs including the Woolpack at Slad, The Butcher's Arms in Sheepscombe and The Oak in Painswick. If you are coming without transport, we are very happy to pick you and your bags up from a local point or to take you locally for something to eat.
short_description: Farm View House is new this year to the Bed and Breakfast market and offers peaceful and relaxing accommodation in the country near Painswick, Sheepscombe and Stroud.

name: Cotswold Lodge Cedar House
description: Luxury self contained Cotswold stone 1 bedroom lodge with its own driveway, located in a picturesque Cotswold village within the grounds of a C16th country house. Explore the narrow village streets or use us as great base for walking or cycling the Cotswold Way. Spend your evenings watching the sunset on the wooden deck or visiting the local pubs and restaurants. Newly converted luxury self contained 1 bedroom lodge with double sofa bed for families with young children. The spacious lodge provides over 750sq ft of floor space and features an underfloor heated open plan kitchen/living/dining room with access to a private wooden deck via bifold doors.
short_description: Luxury self contained Cotswold stone 1 bedroom lodge with its own driveway, located in a picturesque Cotswold village within the grounds of a C16th country house.

name: St Michael's Painswick
description: Overlooking the famous village church in the heart of Painswick, the Cotswold charm sets the scene for the exceptional boutique accommodation inside. Sympathetically remodelled, the first and second floors of the C17th Century Grade II listed building now offer three luxurious double guest rooms, and two larger suites ideal for families with children or couples seeking spacious accommodation. Each individually-themed room, sumptuously decorated and tastefully furnished, features carefully curated objets and art. Bedlinen is Egyptian cotton, and we offer a choice of goose down or anti-allergenic duvet and pillows.
short_description: Overlooking the famous village church in the heart of Painswick, the Cotswold charm sets the scene for the exceptional boutique accommodation inside.

name: Hammonds Farm Bed & Breakfast
description: A new, luxury country Bed & Breakfast with sweeping views over the beautiful Stroud valleys. Freshly baked biscuits on arrival. Located near the pretty Cotswold market town of Stroud, Hammonds Farm is nestled in 100 acres of grassy farmland, resident to a large herd of alpacas, small flocks of Cotswold and Zwartbles sheep and the two much-loved horses Betty and Cob. The newly renovated farmhouse sits within landscaped gardens featuring pear and espalier apple trees, as well as a patio with one of the best views in the area to complement evening drinks at sundown. Gin optional.
short_description: A new, luxury country Bed & Breakfast with sweeping views over the beautiful Stroud valleys. Freshly baked biscuits on arrival.

name: The Clothiers Arms
description: Down-to-earth family friendly pub with excellent food and drink. Bar area features pool table, comfy sofa area and wood-burning fire. Beautiful beer garden with views across Gloucestershire, kids adventure playground and ample free parking. Restaurant serves traditional English pub food at reasonable prices. Friendly B&B with cosy rooms, all en-suite except one with private bathroom across hall. All rooms have television and tea/coffee making facilities. Traditional breakfast served in restaurant.
short_description: Down-to-earth family friendly pub with excellent food and drink. Bar area features pool table, comfy sofa area and wood-burning fire.

name: Cardynham House
description: Enter the little door and step back in time for a truly unique break. Cardynham House is graded Four star 'Guest Accommodation' by the Quality in Tourism. Located in Painswick, the Queen of the Cotswold's, Cardynham House is a 15th-16th Century Grade 2* listed building originally belonging to a wool merchant. There is wealth of character to be found in every room, each decorated in a style of its own. Each bedroom features not only a unique style but also a four poster or half tester bed and every room has an en suite bathroom with bath, shower or both. Choose from Medieval Garden, Palm Beach, Old Tuscany, The Highlands, Dovecote, New England, Cottage Rose, Arabian Nights and the Pool Room. All rooms at Cardynham House are spacious and have tea and coffee making facilities, television, hair dryer and direct dial telephone configured for incoming direct dialled calls.
short_description: Enter the little door and step back in time for a truly unique break. Cardynham House is graded Four star 'Guest Accommodation' by the Quality in Tourism.

name: Court House Manor
description: Court House Manor in Painswick is a gorgeous Grade 1 listed home available for Bed & Breakfast, events and exclusive hire. Refurbished by owner Linda Lloyd and opened as a Bed & Breakfast in 2013, the property has been restored to an exceptional standard, sympathetic to the past. Court House Manor is steeped in history, with previous guests including King Charles I during the 1643 Seige of Gloucester – it is said that his ghost haunts the four acres of landscaped gardens. At Court House Manor, we offer our 14 rooms for Luxury Bed & Breakfast, as well as exclusive hire for events and family getaways.
short_description: Court House Manor in Painswick is a gorgeous Grade 1 listed home available for Bed & Breakfast, events and exclusive hire.

name: Falcon Inn Painswick
description: Dating back to 1554 the Falcon is a small, select hotel and restaurant situated in the centre of the beautiful Cotswold village of Painswick. Overlooking the historic village church and it's famous 99 clipped yew trees, the Falcon hotel offers great hospitality with a warm welcome. In a hilltop setting, surrounded by stunning Cotswold countryside, the charming village of Painswick is an historic wool town which boasts a fine array of listed buildings sitting in narrow, winding streets. Painswick is one of the most picturesque Cotswold Villages and provides a perfect base from which to explore The Cotswolds and surrounding areas. Our 11 individually styled bedrooms provide comfortable accommodation and our welcoming restaurant and bar offer delicious home cooked food and a wide selection of drinks, wines and real ales.
short_description: Dating back to 1554 the Falcon is a small, select hotel and restaurant situated in the centre of the beautiful Cotswold village of Painswick.

name: Hambutts Mynd
description: Wonderful views from all the windows. Right on the Trail and 3 minutes into centre of Painswick. Electric blankets on beds and heating in spring, autumn and winter. HAMBUTTS MYND was built in the 1700s as a corn mill, which was driven by a windmill. It still has the original beam and character. In 1800s it was converted into the first Girls School in the Gloucester village of Painswick and then in latter years it was converted into a normal dwelling house which is now run as a renowned Bed and Breakfast by John and Elizabeth.
short_description: Wonderful views from all the windows. Right on the Trail and 3 minutes into centre of Painswick. Electric blankets on beds and heating in spring, autumn and winter.

name: Mayfield Studio Painswick
description: Mayfield Studio is a spacious, self-contained, comfortable and contemporary apartment on a quiet lane in Painswick, minutes away from the Cotswold Way in Gloucestershire. The space is suited for a couple but can accomodate three people. There is a small kitchen where light meals can be prepared and a luxurious slate-lined bathroom. There is WiFi, TV and DVD with films, books, guide-books, maps, games and magazines for guests to enjoy. Breakfast of your choice is provided. Walking boots, bikes and clothes can be cleaned or laundered by arrangement. There is off-road parking.
short_description: Mayfield Studio is a spacious, self-contained, comfortable and contemporary apartment on a quiet lane in Painswick, minutes away from the Cotswold Way in Gloucestershire.

name: St Annes B&B Painswick
description: St Anne's B&B, Painswick, is a former wool merchant's house in the heart of Painswick with antiques, a log fire and relaxed family atmosphere. We have several good places to eat within strides of our house. Ideal for weary Cotswold Way walkers, muddy boots, bikes and dogs welcome. We can arrange a pick up/drop off service for those planning a 2 night stay (especially if you are having problems finding accommodation a day's walk north of us on the Cotswold Way). We provide a washing and drying service, packed lunches and can also organise luggage transfers for you. Please ring if you would like to bring a dog. Dogs accepted by prior arrangement in only one of our rooms. A charge of £7 per night applies.
short_description: St Anne's B&B, Painswick, is a former wool merchant's house in the heart of Painswick with antiques, a log fire and relaxed family atmosphere.

name: Yew Tree Cottage Harescombe
description: Nestled in the rural hamlet and valley of Harescombe, originally two Cotswold Stone farm cottages built in 1882. Within a short walking distance of the Cotswold Way, our Bed and Breakfast is ideal for anyone walking the Cotswold way and looking for comfortable, warm, affordable accommodation. The area is renowned for its country charm and tranquillity, steeped in history stretching back to the English civil war and beyond. Within the village stands the 13th Century St. John the Baptist Church, which boasted the oldest church bell in Gloucestershire. A grade II* listed building, with its table-top tombs and unique civil war graffiti dating back to the 1600s. Across the valley, is the famous Cotswold Way trail providing panoramic views from Haresfield Beacon over the Severn Valley and beyond to the Black Mountains.
short_description: Nestled in the rural hamlet and valley of Harescombe, originally two Cotswold Stone farm cottages built in 1882.

name: The Painswick Hotel
description: Sixteen beautifully furnished bedrooms and a restaurant featuring seasonal Cotswolds cuisine. Includes The Hearth café, full bar with wines and cocktails, Games Room, and two spa treatment rooms offering massage and beauty treatments through Elemis and Leighton Denny. Located in Painswick village near Cheltenham with access to valley and hill walks.
short_description: Sixteen beautifully furnished bedrooms and a restaurant featuring seasonal Cotswolds cuisine.

name: Tibbiwell Lodge
description: Tibbiwell Lodge is a purpose-built B&B designed with you in mind. 200 yards from Painswick town centre and nestled into the side of the valley, Tibbiwell Lodge feels as if it is miles from anywhere. With its fantastic views and superb location it is the perfect place to get away from it all whilst still having all facilities within walking distance. Painswick is an area of outstanding natural beauty and the Lodge benefits from beautiful views over the valley, a fact which has been taken into consideration when designing your rooms. The south-facing rooms all have balconies or terraces for you to enjoy these views to the full. The comfortable oak-floored Dining Room with its open fireplace is generous in size and nicely proportioned for you to be able to enjoy your breakfast chosen from our comprehensive menu.
short_description: Tibbiwell Lodge is a purpose-built B&B designed with you in mind. 200 yards from Painswick town centre and nestled into the side of the valley, Tibbiwell Lodge feels as if it is miles from anywhere.

name: Ashton House Painswick
description: All rooms have private bathroom or shower room. If there is an extra member of the same party, the single bedroom shares the shower room. There is a TV in each room, tea/coffee making facilities, holiday reading.
short_description: All rooms have private bathroom or shower room. If there is an extra member of the same party, the single bedroom shares the shower room.

name: Wickham Grange
description: Credit card deposits accepted on line using Paypal. Transport to and from walks, packed lunches and evening meals by prior arrangement. All our food is locally sourced and organic wherever possible, including home made bread and preserves.
short_description: Credit card deposits accepted on line using Paypal. Transport to and from walks, packed lunches and evening meals by prior arrangement.

name: The Fox & Maple
description: Family run pub with 4 ensuite letting rooms and dining. The pub sits in the village of Wickwar and dates back to the 16th century. Previously called The Buthay, it was renamed The Fox & Maple a couple of years ago. Features a large car park, beer garden, separate dining area, bar, and pool table with low-level background music. Located less than 5 miles from Hawkesbury Upton, offering respite for walkers and villagers.
short_description: Family run pub with 4 ensuite letting rooms and dining. The pub sits in the village of Wickwar and dates back to the 16th century.

name: Swan Hotel Wotton
description: This 17th century Hotel is situated in the beautiful and historic town of Wotton-under-Edge. Next to a free car park and only 10 minutes from the M5, stay with us and enjoy the stunning views of the Southern Cotswolds. Situated under the leafy edge of the Cotswold Way, The Swan Hotel is a converted 17th century coaching inn that seamlessly blends modern comforts with traditional touches to create a unique hotel experience. Situated in the heart of Wotton-under-Edge, The Swan offers thirteen beautiful recently refurbished en-suite guest rooms, a light and airy restaurant offering freshly cooked food, and cosy bar and snug that retain a local feel. We're a dog friendly hotel, and while the Cotswolds makes the perfect playground for your four-legged friends, we also have our very own soft-play area for your little ones to explore – Lilly's Pad.
short_description: This 17th century Hotel is situated in the beautiful and historic town of Wotton-under-Edge.

name: Hawks View

short_description: One double en suite room. Evening meal and packed lunch available.

name: The Fox Inn Hawkesbury
description: The Fox Inn is situated in the centre of the historic village of Hawkesbury Upton. The 18th Century building was originally a coaching inn, but today is a typical village pub with a warm and friendly atmosphere, enhanced by the real fire in winter. The large historical skittle alley has been converted into a 60 cover restaurant, boasting a beautiful artwork along one wall, specialising in local, seasonal fayre. The Fox Inn has four rooms available for Bed & Breakfast bookings on a per night basis. All four rooms are furnished with a double bed, en-suite bathrooms, TV and complimentary tea & coffee making facilities. Two of the rooms also have a single bed so can be used as twin rooms or as family rooms. Accommodation is available from Tuesday through to Saturday.
short_description: The Fox Inn is situated in the centre of the historic village of Hawkesbury Upton.

name: The Haven Wotton
description: The Haven is self-catering accommodation in Wotton-under-Edge, Gloucestershire, situated three minutes from the Cotswold Way. It features elevated positioning with south-facing views of open countryside. Located five minutes from town center with access to pubs, restaurants, and shops. Two upstairs bedrooms, single bathroom with bath and separate shower, well-appointed kitchen/diner downstairs with WC.
short_description: The Haven is self-catering accommodation in Wotton-under-Edge, Gloucestershire, situated three minutes from the Cotswold Way.

name: Chipping House
description: Chipping House is a 'Home from Home' for families and groups of friends. This beautiful Georgian dwelling on the Cotswolds Way is spacious with nooks and crannies for relaxation. Over 200 years old, it features architectural elements like ships' beams. Amenities include stashes of books, games, toys, a piano, and music system.
short_description: Chipping House is a 'Home from Home' for families and groups of friends. This beautiful Georgian dwelling on the Cotswolds Way is spacious with nooks and crannies for relaxation.
