description: A well equipped 2 bedroom chalet situated down a private gravel driveway hidden from the road. Will sleep up to 3 people.
short_description: A well equipped 2 bedroom chalet situated down a private gravel driveway hidden from the road. Will sleep up to 3 people.

name: The Cheltenham Town House
description: With 21 bedrooms and 5 studio apartments our accommodation suits most Cheltenham hotel requirements. On the northern edge of the Town Centre, we are ideally located for the racecourse, Centaur and Pittville Pump Rooms. Complemented by our scrumptious breakfasts, free Wi-Fi and our 'what you are quoted is what you pay' policy we offer truly exceptional value for money to the corporate and leisure traveller. The variety afforded by the individually designed rooms in this grand regency property means that we can match a range of budgets. Parking is charged at £2 per night per car. There is also free overnight parking in the local vicinity.
short_description: With 21 bedrooms and 5 studio apartments our accommodation suits most Cheltenham hotel requirements.

name: Stratton House
description: This is a deceptively spacious self-catering house with 5 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms sleeping up to 10 people in single beds. Bedroom 1. downstairs family room with double and twin. Bedroom 2. Triple room. downstairs bathroom with shower. Bedroom 3. Twin or superking with ensuite bath and shower. Bedroom 4. Twin with ensuite shower. Bedroom 5. Single with shower room opposite.

name: Gambles Farm
description: Gambles Farm is a luxury, country farmhouse set in the Cotswolds. We have been successfully providing our guests with a comfortable and welcoming stay since 2002 and continue to do so. Gambles Farm is surrounded by acres of beautiful scenery; including the stunning views of Cleeve Hill. Our farmhouse is also the home to our friendly dogs, horses, chickens, goat, and our pet pig, Percy. Gambles Farm provides a welcoming, homely stay for all ages. Offering large comfortable en-suite bedrooms and a hearty home-cooked breakfast to your liking – (using free-range eggs from our own chickens!) We ensure all of our guests have a pleasant and comfortable stay and look forward to visiting again.
short_description: Gambles Farm is a luxury, country farmhouse set in the Cotswolds. We have been successfully providing our guests with a comfortable and welcoming stay since 2002 and continue to do so.

name: Albemarle Gate
description: Light and airy non-smoking semi detached self catering house overlooking Pittville park towards Pittville Lake and is just a 10 minute stroll to the racecourse, The Centaur and The Pump rooms. Cheltenham town centre is less than a mile. The nearby Spar shop sells all basic provisions, newspapers and licensed to sell alcohol. The Cheltenham Leisure centre is also close on hand and membership is not required. The leisure centre has an indoor swimming pool, sauna, steam room, jacuzzi, squash courts, fitness suite, running track, exercise classes as well as a licensed bar and cafeteria.
short_description: Light and airy non-smoking semi detached self catering house overlooking Pittville park towards Pittville Lake and is just a 10 minute stroll to the racecourse, The Centaur and The Pump rooms.

One of the bathrooms sits in between the 2 bedrooms and is a 'Jack & Jill' bathroom with locks on both doors allowing guests to choose between privacy or open plan living for younger families. We have a BBQ on our patio, a fridge, kettle, toaster but please note not a kitchen. We also have some good relationships with some great local Take Aways such as a sushi company and a high end dinner service.

name: Sam's Studio Apartment
description: Newly refurbished, self-contained studio apartment located on the first floor. A lovely, bright living space boasting original features, yet has a modern and stylish decor throughout. name: Hotel du Vin Cheltenham
description: Housed within this impressive building in the chic Montpellier district of Cheltenham are 49 timelessly styled bedrooms and stunning suites. Our Cheltenham hotel has a variety of rooms to choose from including standard, superior, executive and suites which feature signature du Vin roll-top baths. You'll discover luxuries such as handsprung mattresses, fine Egyptian linen, deep baths and powerful drench showers, plasma TVs and air conditioning. Our Cheltenham hotel features 49 distinctive rooms and suites, each with a huge hand-sprung mattress, delightfully soft Egyptian cotton bed linen, and a deep roll-top bath or monsoon shower.
short_description: Housed within this impressive building in the chic Montpellier district of Cheltenham are 49 timelessly styled bedrooms and stunning suites.

name: Queens Hotel Cheltenham
description: One of the first purpose-built hotels in Europe, Queens Hotel was built on the site of the old Sherborne Spa. A fine example of neo-classical architecture with imposing white façade, tall Corinthian columns, and Georgian windows, modelled on the Temple of Jupiter in Rome. Opened on 21st July 1838, named in honour of Queen Victoria. The hotel has been Grade II listed since 1955 and retains many original features including Pugin-designed wallpaper and a Georgian staircase with crowned glass roof. Recently underwent complete restoration. Each of the 84 rooms are classically elegant with Egyptian cotton linen, luxury toiletries, spa shower head, flat screen TV, air cooling, safe and complimentary Wi-Fi.
short_description: One of the first purpose-built hotels in Europe, Queens Hotel was built on the site of the old Sherborne Spa.

name: Wellinghill Lodge
description: Wellinghill Lodge is a self-catering accommodation nestling between fields down a quiet lane, offering modern, light homely accommodation. The open plan kitchen/living/dining area features a dining table, comfy seating, and fully equipped kitchen. The pretty double bedroom has an en-suite shower room. Outside there is off-road parking and a private garden area with separate viewing balcony offering fantastic views. Access to the Cotswold Way is just down the lane.
short_description: Wellinghill Lodge is a self-catering accommodation nestling between fields down a quiet lane, offering modern, light homely accommodation.

name: Balcarras Farm Holiday Cottages
description: Self catering accommodation built in 1992, around three sides of a paved courtyard at the rear of owners former farmhouse and stables, set in 3 acres, the single storey cottages are double glazed, of brick construction, incorporating materials from the original Stables and Cider Mill. Well placed for visiting many typical Cotswold Villages and small towns including Stow-on-the-Wold, Moreton-in-Marsh, Bourton-on-the-Water, Broadway, Cirencester, as well as touring further a field with Gloucester 10 miles, Ross-on-Wye 25 miles, Bath 45 miles, Stratford-on-Avon 30 miles. With the 'Cotswold Way' accessible at several points nearby and a vast network of footpaths in surrounding hills and countryside, walkers and nature lovers are particularly well served.

name: Briarfields Motel & Touring Park
description: Briarfields is a small family owned Adults Only Motel & Touring Caravan and Camping Site. The site is open all year round and located just 2 miles from Regency Cheltenham Spa and 6 miles from Historic Gloucester with an excellent bus service to both. The motel accommodation is all en-suite; offers simple, spotlessly clean and comfortable rooms which are fully equipped with free WiFi throughout, flat-screen TV, microwave, fridge, tea and coffee making facilities, fresh towels and free secure parking. Some of our rooms are on the ground floor adjacent to the touring park with independent access. The motorhome, caravan and camping site is ideally situated for experiencing Regency Cheltenham renowned for its exclusive shopping. There are a total of 72 hard-standing touring pitches and approximately 10 tent pitches in the sheltered camping field.
short_description: Briarfields is a small family owned Adults Only Motel & Touring Caravan and Camping Site.

name: Charlton Kings Hotel
description: The accommodation features 12 air-conditioned rooms with electric kettle and coffee/tea makers. Rooms offer WiFi, complimentary WiFi, tea and coffee facilities. Some units feature garden views. Guests enjoy free English breakfast on premises. The property has a bar with spacious terrace and lounge. Located on eastern edge of Cheltenham, three-quarters mile from Cotswold Way crossing at A40/Dowdeswell Reservoir.
short_description: The accommodation features 12 air-conditioned rooms with electric kettle and coffee/tea makers. Rooms offer WiFi, complimentary WiFi, tea and coffee facilities. Some units feature garden views.

name: Double Tree by Hilton Cheltenham
description: The DoubleTree by Hilton Cheltenham offers 148 elegantly-decorated bedrooms split between the original Manor House and new wing. The newly refurbished hotel features Standard, Deluxe, and Suite rooms with stylish touches, comfortable beds, modern furnishings, and large windows. All bedrooms include desks, USB charging points, and complimentary WiFi. The hotel distinguishes itself through its blend of contemporary decoration with Edwardian heritage and ideal location near Cheltenham Racecourse. Guests can enjoy Lake 53 Restaurant with views of Lilly Brook Lake, Lilley Brook Bar & Lounge, spa and salon services, indoor pool, whirlpool, steam room, sauna, fitness centre, and woodlands walks on the grounds.
short_description: The DoubleTree by Hilton Cheltenham offers 148 elegantly-decorated bedrooms split between the original Manor House and new wing.

name: Hilden Lodge Hotel
description: Welcome to Hilden Lodge, our luxury Bed and Breakfast near Cheltenham. Hilden Lodge is the perfect destination for long weekends or short breaks in Cheltenham and the Cotswolds. Not only is our guesthouse just a few minutes' drive from Cheltenham Town Centre and the Racecourse, but also we have the outstanding Cotswold countryside and idyllic villages on our doorstep making us the ideal Cotswold B&B. Our beautifully decorated ensuite rooms start from £60 per night and include a fabulous award winning breakfast. We can cater for all your needs whether you are a lone traveller on business or a couple on a romantic weekend getaway. We welcome families and larger groups too.
short_description: Welcome to Hilden Lodge, our luxury Bed and Breakfast near Cheltenham. Hilden Lodge is the perfect destination for long weekends or short breaks in Cheltenham and the Cotswolds.

name: Whittington Lodge Farm
description: We do have a minimum of 2 nights stays. However, one night stays may be available nearer to the time, so please telephone for availability. Choice of breakfast, either freshly cooked from our extensive menu or continental, featuring our own free range eggs, pressed apple juice from our orchards, fresh fruit in season, homemade and local breads and fruit loaves, and locally sourced organic food products. Tour of our award winning wildlife and conservation farm available, taking approximately 1 hour in a 4x4 vehicle.
short_description: We do have a minimum of 2 nights stays. However, one night stays may be available nearer to the time, so please telephone for availability.

name: The Greenway Hotel & Spa
description: Our luxury country manor house hotel and spa in Cheltenham offers an indulgent break away of fresh country air, luxurious accommodation in 21 beautifully designed rooms and gorgeous gardens. The Greenway Hotel and Spa in Cheltenham is the ideal place to experience the ultimate in luxury country living and our four AA Silver Star rating ensures you the highest levels of comfort and hospitality. The Greenway Hotel is just the ticket for a weekend getaway with a wealth of luxury at your fingertips. Experience award-winning dining in the 2 AA Rosette restaurant from head chef Marcus McGuinness, but first don't forget to relax on the terrace with a glass of bubbly in hand. To further unwind book an ESPA treatment at Elan Spa, hop in the outdoor hot tub or take a lazy swim in the hydrotherapy pool.
short_description: Our luxury country manor house hotel and spa in Cheltenham offers an indulgent break away of fresh country air, luxurious accommodation in 21 beautifully designed rooms and gorgeous gardens.

name: The Bell Inn Willersey
description: This 17th Century Cotswold stone-built pub overlooks the village green and duck pond in the centre of the picturesque village of Willersey, often described as the most beautiful and natural village in the Cotswolds, giving it a timeless character. The village is a past winner of the Best Kept Village competition. Originally called the Blue Bell Inn, the Bell is set opposite the beautiful Pool Farm House and Sawpit Green. The village's early English church lies just up the lane, with Norman remains and panoramic views from its churchyard. The Bell is a genuine Cotswold country pub with home produced foods, traditional cask ales, fine wines and comfortable bedrooms. There are five bedrooms, Victorian in style and tastefully decorated with beautiful, elegant furnishings.
short_description: This 17th Century Cotswold stone-built pub overlooks the village green and duck pond in the centre of the picturesque village of Willersey, often described as the most beautiful and natural village in.

name: Broadway B&B
description: Set in the beautiful Cotswold town of Broadway, just a ten minute stroll from the lovely centre but set back 200 yards from the road we offer a quiet and peaceful base from which to enjoy Broadway and the rest of this area of outstanding natural beauty. Our range of double rooms are all equipped with quality beds and bedding to help make the most of our tranquil environment. All rooms have oak furnishings, free view LCD TV, Wi-fi, mini-fridge, tea/coffee tray and hairdryer. Soft towels and well equipped en-suite shower and/or bath facilites will add to your comfort. Breakfast is served in our bright and airy breakfast room where quality tableware and delicious local produce combine for the perfect start to your day.
short_description: Set in the beautiful Cotswold town of Broadway, just a ten minute stroll from the lovely centre but set back 200 yards from the road we offer a quiet and peaceful base from which to enjoy Broadway and.

name: Buckland Manor Hotel
description: One of the most elegant country house hotels in the Cotswolds, Buckland Manor is tucked away in a tranquil corner of the village of Buckland, next to the old village church. Set in ten acres of grounds, which blend seamlessly into the village, the beautiful manor house is unmarked by the passing of time; it is an idyllic setting from which to enjoy an exceptionally warm welcome, tantalising menus lovingly crafted from the 'market garden of England' and breath-taking Cotswold scenery. In the heart of the Cotswold tourist trail, Buckland Manor is only a few minutes from the much loved town of Broadway, with its pretty high street and eclectic shops. Staying in Buckland you are well placed to discover the wider area of the Cotswolds, Oxfords dreaming spires and the home of Shakespeare, Stratford upon Avon. The 15 bedrooms at Buckland Manor are luxuriously appointed and provide the highest standards of comfort, all individually furnished with antiques and fine fabrics.
short_description: One of the most elegant country house hotels in the Cotswolds, Buckland Manor is tucked away in a tranquil corner of the village of Buckland, next to the old village church.

name: The Crown & Trumpet
description: Situated just behind the village green of Broadway this traditional 17th Century Inn, built in Cotswold stone, provides Accommodation with five rooms for Midweek and Weekend breaks. Providing Wi-Fi service. Serving Lunch and Dinners all through the week using locally produced ingredients to make seasonally cooked home made dishes at this broadway pub. Being a small Cotswold Inn, we only have five rooms: 4 double rooms, all en-suite with a shower and 1 twin bedded room, en-suite with a shower. All of our rooms are ensuite, furnished to a high standard and include television, wifi, and tea and coffee making services.
short_description: Situated just behind the village green of Broadway this traditional 17th Century Inn, built in Cotswold stone, provides Accommodation with five rooms for Midweek and Weekend breaks.

name: Farncombe Estate
description: Farncombe Estate is perfectly placed for a short stay or holiday in the north Cotswolds. Our 400 acre private country estate is surrounded by pretty market towns, great pubs and gorgeous gardens to visit, with the Cotswold Way running by our doorstep. Offered on the Estate: 89 modern ensuite bedrooms with free Wifi, Locally sourced and home made food served in the restaurant, Stunning views over Broadway, the Vale of Evesham and beyond, Fully equipped lounge bar, Delicious Bar Snack menu, Generous rates available from local firms offering luggage transport
short_description: Farncombe Estate is perfectly placed for a short stay or holiday in the north Cotswolds.

name: Mill Hay House
description: Mill Hay is a Queen Anne country house located in a tranquil setting within easy walking distance of Broadway. The house welcomes a select number of guests to enjoy the luxurious accommodation as a country retreat. Mill Hay will accepts no more than six guests on a bed and breakfast basis at anytime to ensure your well earned break is as private and exclusive as you deserve.
short_description: Mill Hay is a Queen Anne country house located in a tranquil setting within easy walking distance of Broadway.

name: Rookery Farm Shepherds Huts Broadway
description: Situated on the family run Rookery Farm, home to our pedigree Suffolk sheep, our Shepherds huts offer a unique form of accommodation for your glamping experience on the hill above Broadway village. The surrounding Cotswold countryside is beautiful and the views from the Shepherd Huts are quite stunning. Situated in the idilic Cotswold countryside, our Shepherds Huts make a great base for exploring this beautiful region of England, being a short drive from the A44 and backing onto the Cotswold Way. Not only that but we fall under the shadow of the iconic Broadway Tower, a great visitor's attraction itself. We have three authentic Shepherds Huts available for hire, each capable of accommodating two people. Our huts are available all year round from £60 a night.
short_description: Situated on the family run Rookery Farm, home to our pedigree Suffolk sheep, our Shepherds huts offer a unique form of accommodation for your glamping experience on the hill above Broadway village.

name: Russell's of Broadway
description: Russell's is housed in the old workshop of 20th Century British furniture designer Sir Gordon Russell. Opened in 2004 following restoration, it's an elegant 'restaurant with rooms' featuring a modern airy restaurant with terrace and private dining on the ground floor, with seven individually designed bedrooms. All rooms include en-suite bathrooms, luxury bedlinen, air conditioning, flat screen televisions, broadband internet access and original architectural features. A full English breakfast is included. Guests receive free entry to the Gordon Russell Design Museum in Broadway.
short_description: Russell's is housed in the old workshop of 20th Century British furniture designer Sir Gordon Russell.

name: Sheepscombe Byre Holiday Cottage
description: Situated in the heart of the Cotswolds in Snowshill, near Broadway, Sheepscombe Byre holiday cottage sleeps four (4) in 2 lovely, comfortable bedrooms. Sheepscombe Byre holiday home boasts 2 en suite bedrooms, each with a King Size double bed: the Green Room's 6ft Super King Size bed, can be set up as Twin 3 ft beds if you prefer. You will be warmed and cosseted by the underfloor heating and woodburner downstairs and by the central heating throughout. The beautifully equipped cook's kitchen caters for up to 6 people and includes an oven, hob, microwave, dishwasher, fridge-freezer, food processor and a ridiculously full drawer of implements of all sorts. Fresh meat and vegetables and the finest quality ingredients can be bought locally.
short_description: Situated in the heart of the Cotswolds in Snowshill, near Broadway, Sheepscombe Byre holiday cottage sleeps four (4) in 2 lovely, comfortable bedrooms.

name: Windrush House
description: Windrush House is located metres from the village centre, providing a quiet place to relax. Features include ample free parking, a comfortable guest lounge with books and games, and a large landscaped garden. Wi-Fi is available throughout. The establishment emphasises classical contemporary guest accommodation with values of courtesy, politeness, consistency and competency. Owners Kate and Robin provide a warm welcome, alongside Phoenix the dog from a local rescue home.
short_description: Windrush House is located metres from the village centre, providing a quiet place to relax.

name: The Bantam Tea Rooms & Accommocation
description: The Bantam Tea Rooms and Guest House is a traditional English Tea Room that offers excellent bed and breakfast accommodation. We are nestled in the heart of the historic market town of Chipping Campden. The Bantam Tea Rooms was built in 1693 and directly overlooks the 17th Century Market Hall. The Bantam is situated on the High Street amongst beautifully preserved listed buildings of golden Cotswold stone, many of which date between the 14th and 17th century. Double, twin & single bedded rooms in delightful character accommodation. Our stylish en-suite rooms are tastefully decorated with a comfortable and cosy feel. There is a peaceful, private guest lounge and throughout the winter months you can enjoy your delicious breakfast by our roaring log fire.
short_description: The Bantam Tea Rooms and Guest House is a traditional English Tea Room that offers excellent bed and breakfast accommodation.

name: Campden Yurts Hillside Nursery
description: Two luxurious yurts on the outskirts of Chipping Campden welcoming individuals, couples, families and small groups. Each yurt has a king/double bed, 2 double futons, wood burner and stove. All bedding is provided, and wood for the woodburner. Each has a private bathroom very close by with electric shower, flushing toilet and sink. Access to excellent cooking facilities as well as fridge, microwave, electric kettle and toaster. Outside you can relax in a hammock or make memories a round a campfire. We can take up to 5 adults or a family of 6 in each yurt.
short_description: Two luxurious yurts on the outskirts of Chipping Campden welcoming individuals, couples, families and small groups. Each yurt has a king/double bed, 2 double futons, wood burner and stove.

name: The Chance
description: The Chance is a Traditional family home offering Bed & Breakfast accommodation to guests in the beautiful North Cotswold Medieval Market town of Chipping Campden. We currently have 2 guest rooms available, our Kiftsgate Room which is in the house and our Hidcote Room which is accessed from our rear garden offering perhaps a little more privacy for guests as it is set away from the main house. Both rooms share very similar facilities: Super King Size beds 6ft/USA King (twin on request) silent fridge with complimentary fresh milk & bottled water, TV/DVD radio alarm, hairdryer and tea/coffee making facilities and free WIFI.
short_description: The Chance is a Traditional family home offering Bed & Breakfast accommodation to guests in the beautiful North Cotswold Medieval Market town of Chipping Campden.

name: Cotswold House Hotel & Spa
description: Nestled in the heart of Chipping Campden, the award winning Cotswold House Hotel & Spa is a charming, Grade II listed Regency town house, complete with a tranquil spa, relaxed bistro and formal dining via our Fig restaurant. Our central location offers up picturesque Cotswold scenery from every window; be that rolling hills and nearby fields, or the honey-coloured architecture of the town centre. Stay in the heart of the Cotswold's in the beautiful picturesque village of Chipping Campden. Our 28 en suite bedrooms, contemporary designed yet with a dash of country-chic, look out over scenic streets, rolling hills or manicured gardens depending on location.
short_description: Nestled in the heart of Chipping Campden, the award winning Cotswold House Hotel & Spa is a charming, Grade II listed Regency town house, complete with a tranquil spa, relaxed bistro and formal dining.

name: Crafty Cottages
description: THREE COTSWOLD COTTAGES Crafty Cottage, Number Five and Number Six Sheep Street are our three self catering cottages in the very heart of Chipping Campden. They stand side by side infront of the Old Silk Mill where the Arts and Crafts history of the town began. Crafty Cottage has 1 bedroom and accommodates 1 or 2 people, Number Five has 1 bedroom and accommodates 1 or 2 people, Number Six has 2 bedrooms (1 double, 1 king size or twin on request) and can accommodate up to four guests comfortably. All the facillities of Chipping Campden are within a very easy walking distance. Crafty Cottage has a garden with seated area, Number Five has a rear courtyard with outdoor seating & is planted with box hedge & seasonal flowers, and Number Six has a small rear courtyard with seated area.
short_description: THREE COTSWOLD COTTAGES Crafty Cottage, Number Five and Number Six Sheep Street are our three self catering cottages in the very heart of Chipping Campden.

name: The Honeypot
description: A luxury period cottage located only a 1 minute walk from the start (or the end!) of The Cotswold Way. Beds for 3/4 people, comfortable beds and sofas and beautifully finished. Located close to pubs and restaurants. No on line payments accepted but bookings over the telephone, bank transfer, Pay-Pal, cheque accepted. Hampers easily arranged with local produce. Luggage transfers and transport can be arranged however this depends on notice and availability of our provider.
short_description: A luxury period cottage located only a 1 minute walk from the start (or the end!) of The Cotswold Way. Beds for 3/4 people, comfortable beds and sofas and beautifully finished.

name: The Kings Hotel
description: The Kings Hotel is a beautiful, boutique town house hotel tucked away in 'the green and pleasant land' of the Cotswolds, with its golden stone buildings and picture perfect villages. The Kings is defined by its eclectic style. The fourteen main house bedrooms are all delightfully individual and have been designed in deference to traditional Cotswold charm but with a modern twist. The five cottage rooms, set apart from the main house, are decorated to the highest standards with beautiful furnishings and lavish bathrooms. All rooms include WiFi access, TV, tea and coffee facilities and hairdryer.
short_description: The Kings Hotel is a beautiful, boutique town house hotel tucked away in 'the green and pleasant land' of the Cotswolds, with its golden stone buildings and picture perfect villages.

name: Manor Farm Guesthouse
description: Manor Farm is a beautifully restored and renovated traditional oak-beamed farmhouse built in 1624 which has been in our family for 5 generations. All bedrooms are en-suite with TV, radio, tea & coffee making facilities, and all are centrally heated.
short_description: Manor Farm is a beautifully restored and renovated traditional oak-beamed farmhouse built in 1624 which has been in our family for 5 generations.

name: The Red Lion Inn
description: The Red Lion has been providing cosy overnight accommodation to weary travellers for many centuries. The adjoining cottage, with its well appointed newly refurbished rooms with en-suite facilities, offers the chance to getaway from it all for the weekend or a bed for those who enjoy their wine, but don't want to drive. Each room has a hospitality tray with tea & coffee making facilities plus soft towels and complimentary toiletries. Rates are per room per night & include a Full English Breakfast. Children 12 years of age and over are charged at an additional cost of £20.00 per night (for use of extra bed) inclusive of breakfast.
short_description: The Red Lion has been providing cosy overnight accommodation to weary travellers for many centuries.

name: The Seagrave Arms
description: The Seagrave Arms is a charming Cotswolds inn and restaurant with eight en-suite guestrooms. Set in the heart of the Cotswolds, mid-way between the villages of Chipping Campden (1 mile) and Broadway (3 miles) and just 20 minutes drive from both Cheltenham and Stratford upon Avon. We source and purchase all of our food from local farms and suppliers and stock our bar with award-winning real local ales and gin from Cotswolds Distillery, just 20 minutes down the road. A Grade II listed building and clad in the classic honey-hued Cotswolds stone, The Seagrave Arms was originally built 400 years ago as a family home and we've kept that cosy, homely feel within our bedrooms. Each one of our eight beautifully appointed en suite rooms have been individually decorated and have their own distinct character.
short_description: The Seagrave Arms is a charming Cotswolds inn and restaurant with eight en-suite guestrooms.

name: Stonecroft B&B
description: Stonecroft Bed & Breakfast is just a two minute walk from the historic high street of Chipping Campden and therefore within easy reach of the many pubs, restaurants and shop. The gardens boast a large patio and seating area with a delightful stream running through. Our tastefully decorated rooms are so arranged that we can accommodate a twin and double, two doubles or, a family room for four and a further double all with en-suite facilities and Flat panel TV with Freeview & integrated DVD player, Hot Drinks Tray, Hair Dryer & Radio alarm, Full Central Heating, Wireless Internet Access.
short_description: Stonecroft Bed & Breakfast is just a two minute walk from the historic high street of Chipping Campden and therefore within easy reach of the many pubs, restaurants and shop.

name: Taplins
description: A warm and friendly welcome is assured at Taplins, an award winning family run bed and breakfast located in the picturesque market town of Chipping Campden, located at the start of the Cotswold Way. Built from traditional honey coloured Cotswold stone, Taplins Bed and Breakfast is set within pretty gardens and provides ample private parking for guests. Recently refurbished and tastefully decorated with antiques from the family antique shop in Chipping Campden, our en-suite guest rooms benefit from fabulous countryside vistas, all of which provide the perfect setting for you to enjoy a comfortable and relaxing stay.
short_description: A warm and friendly welcome is assured at Taplins, an award winning family run bed and breakfast located in the picturesque market town of Chipping Campden, located at the start of the Cotswold Way.

name: The Volunteer Inn
description: The Volunteer Inn is a 17th century pub with a friendly and welcoming atmosphere, offering unpretentious value for money accommodation, from £35 per person on a bed and breakfast basis within a peaceful location in Chipping Campden. We serve a fabulous selection of Indian and English dishes, available in the Maharaja Restaurant and real ale in the bar. The Inn is only a few hundred yards from the town centre, with the Cotswold way at its door step. A cobbled courtyard, outdoor TV and well maintained gardens, leading to a children's play area can be enjoyed during the summer months and a warm cosy log fire in the winter.
short_description: The Volunteer Inn is a 17th century pub with a friendly and welcoming atmosphere, offering unpretentious value for money accommodation, from £35 per person on a bed and breakfast basis within a peacef.

name: Woolmarket House
description: Set at the heart of Chipping Campden, perfectly located overlooking the marker stone for the start or end of the Cotswold Way, Woolmarket House offers luxury award-winning boutique-style bed and breakfast accommodation. Full of period charm, each of the four rooms feature designer fabrics, treasured-antiques, large comfy beds, in-room entertainment, contemporary en-suite bathrooms and gorgeous-scented eco-friendly products to pamper yourself with. It is the perfect stopping place to explore the area of outstanding natural beauty, to embark on your adventure along the Cotswold Way, or to celebrate your journey's end.
short_description: Set at the heart of Chipping Campden, perfectly located overlooking the marker stone for the start or end of the Cotswold Way, Woolmarket House offers luxury award-winning boutique-style bed and break.

name: Dukes Hotel Bath
description: Dukes Bath is situated on Great Pulteney Street and is less than a 10 minute, level walk to the Abbey, the Roman Baths and the centre of the World Heritage City. With its numerous restaurants, pubs, museums and not to forget the wonderful architecture, Dukes offers an ideal place to relax, enjoy and explore the various attractions that Bath has to offer. Built over 200 years ago, Dukes comprises of two townhouses and is original in style and décor.
short_description: Dukes Bath is situated on Great Pulteney Street and is less than a 10 minute, level walk to the Abbey, the Roman Baths and the centre of the World Heritage City.

name: Bath YMCA
description: Bath YMCA is a centrally located 3*** hostel in a Victorian building overlooking Broad Street. It offers dormitory and private accommodation (single, twin, double, triple, quad rooms) with shared bathroom facilities. The hostel features a 24-hour reception, light breakfast included, free internet, laundry facilities, and discounted access to an on-site health and fitness centre. Staff can assist with tour bookings and local recommendations. Conference facilities available. Can accommodate over 200 guests nightly. No lift available; ground floor rooms available upon request.
short_description: Bath YMCA is a centrally located 3*** hostel in a Victorian building overlooking Broad Street.

name: Travelodge Bath Central
description: Enjoy the beauty of Bath from the centrally located Travelodge Bath Central hotel. Take in the historic sites, stunning architecture and the mineral-rich waters at the city's spas. Visit the Roman Baths or discover Bath Abbey – both a 5-minute walk from the hotel. Then wander the pretty streets, browse the shops or stop for afternoon tea. All standard double rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a wide variety of food and drink choices within easy walking distance from this hotel.
short_description: Enjoy the beauty of Bath from the centrally located Travelodge Bath Central hotel. Take in the historic sites, stunning architecture and the mineral-rich waters at the city's spas.

name: Travelodge Bath City Centre
description: Situated in the heart of Bath, the Travelodge Bath City Centre hotel is literally only minutes away from the historic Roman Baths, Bath Abbey, Southgate Mall and the Theatre Royal to name but a few. From the hotel, you're perfectly placed for a stroll through Bath's picturesque Georgian streets. And there's a whole host of theatres, cinemas and shops plus plenty of tea rooms and restaurants right on your doorstep. All standard double rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet.
short_description: Situated in the heart of Bath, the Travelodge Bath City Centre hotel is literally only minutes away from the historic Roman Baths, Bath Abbey, Southgate Mall and the Theatre Royal to name but a few.

name: Pipley Barn
description: This charming converted barn on the Cotswold Way, approximately 4 miles from Bath city centre, offers flexible accommodation for families, walkers and other groups. Pipley Barn is ideal for those wanting a rural base from which to explore the city of Bath or the local countryside and provides the perfect final stopover point for Cotswold Way hikers. Dogs are welcome! We are adjacent to Lansdown Golf course, half a mile from the main road and access is down our rather bumpy track. That barn lies in the corner of a wild meadow which is full of wild flowers and butterflies in the summer, and nearby we have some beautiful mature beech woodland which is much loved by local dog-walkers.
short_description: This charming converted barn on the Cotswold Way, approximately 4 miles from Bath city centre, offers flexible accommodation for families, walkers and other groups.

name: The Kennard Bath
description: The Kennard is located just a few steps away from the heart of Bath, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It was built in 1794, the golden age of Bath's Georgian elegance, as a lodging house to provide accommodation for those coming to spend the season in this delightful city. Henrietta Street is a quiet residential street which is in walking distance from Bath Abbey, the Roman Baths, Pulteney Bridge, Victoria Art Gallery, Holburne Museum and some of the best restaurants and shopping venues. Over many years, the house has been carefully maintained and restored. The Kennard offers twelve recently re-furbished and individually decorated bedrooms on five floors with a fine selection of superior doubles, standard doubles, snug doubles, two singles with shared bathroom, a twin and a triple room.
short_description: The Kennard is located just a few steps away from the heart of Bath, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

name: Brooks Guest House Bath
description: All 22 en-suite bedrooms feature eclectic furnishings with antiques and modern pieces, designer wallpapers, iPod docks, flat-screen TVs, and free WiFi. Bathrooms include Hansgrohe showers and travertine tiles. Award-winning breakfast uses locally-sourced free-range ingredients. Located 350 meters below Royal Crescent, 7 minutes walk from shops, restaurants, and attractions including Roman Baths and Thermae Bath Spa. Parking available at £8 per night. Honesty bar on-site. Children welcome; under 2 stay free.
short_description: All 22 en-suite bedrooms feature eclectic furnishings with antiques and modern pieces, designer wallpapers, iPod docks, flat-screen TVs, and free WiFi.

name: YHA Bath
description: Famed for its grand Georgian architecture and hot springs, Bath is a World Heritage City of many contrasts. It also offers a vibrant nightlife and progressive counter culture to round off your experience. This backpackers hostel provides cheap accommodation for weekend city breaks close to Bath centre and offers hearty breakfasts and quality evening meals in its restaurant.
short_description: Famed for its grand Georgian architecture and hot springs, Bath is a World Heritage City of many contrasts.

name: Bath City Centre Premier Inn
description: Serving up scrumptious steaks and delicious cocktails on-site is Bath Bar + Block.
short_description: Serving up scrumptious steaks and delicious cocktails on-site is Bath Bar + Block.

name: The Belmont B&B
description: A city centre Georgian town house designed by John Wood in 1756. Rooms maintained in original design and modernised accordingly. Ideally situated opposite assembly rooms, circus and Royal Crescent. A short walk to shops and baths. Only 15 minutes walk from the bus and train station. A taxi will cost from £5. All our large ensuite rooms (shower and toilet) are comfortable and tastefully decorated, with all original features, fireplaces etc. We also have two smaller standard rooms (3rd floor) and 2 bathrooms for them to share. All have colour TV, tea and coffee making facilities, hairdryers and are fully centrally heated.
short_description: A city centre Georgian town house designed by John Wood in 1756. Rooms maintained in original design and modernised accordingly. Ideally situated opposite assembly rooms, circus and Royal Crescent.

name: St Christophers Inns Bath
description: St Christopher's Bath is the most central backpacker base in the city. Bath Abbey, the ancient Roman Baths, the modern-day hot spring spa and the famed Royal Crescent are all within minutes of your doorstep when you stay with us. Add to that the many boutique British shops, cafés, pubs and restaurants lining the cobbled streets of this quintessentially British city, and you're in sight-seeing heaven! Free continental breakfast, clean fresh bed linen provided and beds made before arrival, free lockers available in the rooms only (padlock required, can be bought at reception), free Wi-Fi all day, free city walking tour, travel and sightseeing tips at reception, travel towels available to buy at reception, guests receive a 25% discount on food in the bar, bar and restaurant on-site.
short_description: St Christopher's Bath is the most central backpacker base in the city.

name: Marlborough House Bath
description: Marlborough House is a double 4 Star Gold Award rated establishment operated by Peter Moore in a friendly and informal style. It is conveniently close to all of Bath's famous attractions, including the Royal Crescent, Roman Baths, Thermae Spa and fantastic shopping and dining opportunities. AA - 4 Stars & Gold award. English Tourism Council - 4 Stars & Gold award. Very close to Bath City Centre. On street parking available, on-site parking subject to availability and by prior arrangement. Free Air conditioning, Free wi-fi, Flat-screen TV's with Freeview in all guest rooms. Marlborough House has six air conditioned en-suite bedrooms.
short_description: Marlborough House is a double 4 Star Gold Award rated establishment operated by Peter Moore in a friendly and informal style.

name: Haringtons Hotel Bath
description: Tucked away in a quiet, oh-so-traditional cobbled side street, just off the main shopping street in central Bath, Harington's Hotel is a city-smart location for both business and pleasure. Despite being a Grade II Listed building, we haven't had to hold back on any of the business-minded goodies you love. Our boutique bedrooms and serviced apartments all offer free high-speed WiFi, plenty of plug sockets for all your devices, off-site parking (£11 per day) and good-sized workspaces. Feeling peckish? The coffee lounge is open daily from 12noon - 9:00pm, the bar is open all day until 11pm and midnight Friday, Saturday, and room service is available.
short_description: Tucked away in a quiet, oh-so-traditional cobbled side street, just off the main shopping street in central Bath, Harington's Hotel is a city-smart location for both business and pleasure.

name: Devonshire House Bath
description: A friendly, professionally run guesthouse offering five light and airy en suite bedrooms within a twenty-minute walk to Bath's World Heritage City center. The property features a traditional Full English Breakfast served between 8-9 am in a spacious dining room, and provides secure courtyard parking for bikes. A self-catering cottage (Laburnum Cottage) with dog-friendly policy and private parking is also available on the grounds.
short_description: A friendly, professionally run guesthouse offering five light and airy en suite bedrooms within a twenty-minute walk to Bath's World Heritage City center.

name: Cranleigh Bath
description: Cranleigh is an elegant Victorian house with many original period features, located in a peaceful residential area. Dating from 1897 Cranleigh was once a Victorian family home. Now too large for today's family it has been serving bed and breakfast for the past 12 years. Cranleigh can offer you a step back into Victorian style but with all the comforts of modern living. Range of individually decorated and furnished bedrooms. All en-suite with many period features offering every comfort for your stay. Standard Double Rooms, for the price cautious traveller. Classic Rooms with King Size or Twin Beds. Large Superior Rooms with Super-King or Twin Beds. Four Poster Rooms for special occasions. Family Room for upto 2 adults and 2 children. Single Room for Solo Travellers.
short_description: Cranleigh is an elegant Victorian house with many original period features, located in a peaceful residential area. Dating from 1897 Cranleigh was once a Victorian family home.

name: Bath Mill Lodge Retreat
description: Offering exceptional self-catering lodge accommodation in an idyllic, tranquil space, Bath Mill Lodge Retreat is the perfect alternative to a hotel break. Our range of luxury lodges includes everything from cosy, studio-style accommodation, to exquisite 4 bedroom lodge holiday homes. Our lodges in Bath are the perfect place to stay for business or pleasure, as they are fully-equipped with everything you need and more. With a host of established trees and beautiful Newton Brook meandering through the park, you'll feel a million miles from the hustle and bustle of the city.
short_description: Offering exceptional self-catering lodge accommodation in an idyllic, tranquil space, Bath Mill Lodge Retreat is the perfect alternative to a hotel break.
